គុណកន្សោមឆ្លាស់ \((1+\cos x)\)៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{(1-\cos x)(1+\cos x)}{x\sin x(1+\cos x)}\\ &= \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\sin^2 x}{x\sin x(1+\cos x)}\\ &= \lim_{x \to 0} \left(\frac{\sin x}{x} \cdot \frac{1}{1+\cos x}\right)\\ &= 1 \cdot \frac{1}{1+1} = \frac{1}{2} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to \frac{\pi}{4}} \frac{\cos x - \sin x}{\cos 2x}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។
បំបែក \(\cos 2x = \cos^2 x - \sin^2 x\)៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to \frac{\pi}{4}} \frac{\cos x - \sin x}{(\cos x - \sin x)(\cos x + \sin x)}\\ &= \lim_{x \to \frac{\pi}{4}} \frac{1}{\cos x + \sin x}\\ &= \frac{1}{\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2} + \frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}} = \frac{\sqrt{2}}{2} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\sin 3x}{x}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។

\[\begin{aligned} \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\sin 3x}{x} &= \lim_{x \to 0} \left(\frac{\sin 3x}{3x} \cdot 3\right)\\ &= 1 \cdot 3 = 3 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\tan 3x}{2x}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។

\[\begin{aligned} \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\tan 3x}{2x} &= \lim_{x \to 0} \left(\frac{\tan 3x}{3x} \cdot \frac{3}{2}\right)\\ &= 1 \cdot \frac{3}{2} = \frac{3}{2} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\sin 2x}{\sin 5x}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។
ចែកភាគយកនិងភាគបែងនឹង \(x\)៖

\[\begin{aligned} \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\sin 2x}{\sin 5x} &= \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\frac{\sin 2x}{2x} \cdot 2}{\frac{\sin 5x}{5x} \cdot 5}\\ &= \frac{1 \cdot 2}{1 \cdot 5} = \frac{2}{5} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{1-\cos 2x}{x^2}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។
ប្រើរូបមន្ត \(1-\cos 2x = 2\sin^2 x\)៖

\[\begin{aligned} \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{1-\cos 2x}{x^2} &= \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{2\sin^2 x}{x^2}\\ &= 2 \lim_{x \to 0} \left(\frac{\sin x}{x}\right)^2 = 2(1)^2 = 2 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\cos x - \cos^2 x}{x}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។
ទាញ \(\cos x\) ជាកត្តារួម៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to 0} \left(\cos x \cdot \frac{1-\cos x}{x}\right)\\ &= \cos 0 \cdot 0 = 1 \cdot 0 = 0 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\cos 3x - \cos^2 3x}{6x}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។
ទាញ \(\cos 3x\) ជាកត្តារួម៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to 0} \left(\cos 3x \cdot \frac{1-\cos 3x}{3x} \cdot \frac{1}{2}\right)\\ &= 1 \cdot 0 \cdot \frac{1}{2} = 0 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{1-\cos 4x}{x^2}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។
ប្រើរូបមន្ត \(1-\cos 4x = 2\sin^2 2x\)៖

\[\begin{aligned} \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{1-\cos 4x}{x^2} &= \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{2\sin^2 2x}{x^2}\\ &= 2 \lim_{x \to 0} \left(\frac{\sin 2x}{2x}\right)^2 \cdot 4\\ &= 2(1)^2 \cdot 4 = 8 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\sin x - \sin 3x}{x}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។

\[\begin{aligned} \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\sin x - \sin 3x}{x} &= \lim_{x \to 0} \left(\frac{\sin x}{x} - \frac{\sin 3x}{x}\right)\\ &= 1 - 3 = -2 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\sin 2x - 3x}{\sin 3x - 2x}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។
ចែកភាគយកនិងភាគបែងនឹង \(x\)៖

\[\begin{aligned} \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\sin 2x - 3x}{\sin 3x - 2x} &= \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\frac{\sin 2x}{x} - 3}{\frac{\sin 3x}{x} - 2}\\ &= \frac{2 - 3}{3 - 2} = \frac{-1}{1} = -1 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\sin x - 2x}{x - 2\sin x}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។
ចែកភាគយកនិងភាគបែងនឹង \(x\)៖

\[\begin{aligned} \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\sin x - 2x}{x - 2\sin x} &= \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\frac{\sin x}{x} - 2}{1 - 2\frac{\sin x}{x}}\\ &= \frac{1 - 2}{1 - 2(1)} = \frac{-1}{-1} = 1 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{x + \sin x}{2x - 3\sin 2x}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។
ចែកភាគយកនិងភាគបែងនឹង \(x\)៖

\[\begin{aligned} \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{x + \sin x}{2x - 3\sin 2x} &= \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{1 + \frac{\sin x}{x}}{2 - 3\frac{\sin 2x}{x}}\\ &= \frac{1 + 1}{2 - 3(2)} = \frac{2}{-4} = -\frac{1}{2} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{1-\cos^2 x}{3x^2}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។
ប្រើរូបមន្ត \(1-\cos^2 x = \sin^2 x\)៖

\[\begin{aligned} \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{1-\cos^2 x}{3x^2} &= \frac{1}{3} \lim_{x \to 0} \left(\frac{\sin x}{x}\right)^2\\ &= \frac{1}{3}(1)^2 = \frac{1}{3} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{1-\cos 5x}{x^2}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។
ប្រើរូបមន្ត \(1-\cos 5x = 2\sin^2\frac{5x}{2}\)៖

\[\begin{aligned} \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{1-\cos 5x}{x^2} &= \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{2\sin^2\frac{5x}{2}}{x^2}\\ &= 2 \lim_{x \to 0} \left(\frac{\sin\frac{5x}{2}}{\frac{5x}{2}}\right)^2 \cdot \frac{25}{4}\\ &= 2(1)^2 \cdot \frac{25}{4} = \frac{25}{2} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\sin(3x + 1989\pi)}{\sin(4x + 1987\pi)}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។
ដោយ \(\sin(\theta + k\pi) = (-1)^k \sin\theta\)៖

\[\begin{aligned} \sin(3x + 1989\pi) &= -\sin 3x\\ \sin(4x + 1987\pi) &= -\sin 4x \end{aligned}\]
យើងបាន៖
\[\begin{aligned} \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{-\sin 3x}{-\sin 4x} &= \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\frac{\sin 3x}{3x} \cdot 3}{\frac{\sin 4x}{4x} \cdot 4} = \frac{3}{4} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{1-\cos x}{\sin^2 x}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។
ដោយ \(\sin^2 x = 1-\cos^2 x\)៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{1-\cos x}{(1-\cos x)(1+\cos x)}\\ &= \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{1}{1+\cos x} = \frac{1}{1+1} = \frac{1}{2} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \left(\frac{2}{\sin^2 x} - \frac{1}{1-\cos x}\right)\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(\infty - \infty\) ។
តម្រូវភាគបែងរួម \(\sin^2 x = (1-\cos x)(1+\cos x)\)៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{2 - (1+\cos x)}{\sin^2 x}\\ &= \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{1-\cos x}{(1-\cos x)(1+\cos x)}\\ &= \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{1}{1+\cos x} = \frac{1}{2} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\sin x + 1 - \cos x}{x}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to 0} \left(\frac{\sin x}{x} + \frac{1-\cos x}{x}\right)\\ &= 1 + 0 = 1 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\sin x - 2\sin 4x}{\tan x}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។
ចែកភាគយកនិងភាគបែងនឹង \(x\)៖

\[\begin{aligned} \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\sin x - 2\sin 4x}{\tan x} &= \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\frac{\sin x}{x} - 2\frac{\sin 4x}{x}}{\frac{\tan x}{x}}\\ &= \frac{1 - 2(4)}{1} = \frac{1-8}{1} = -7 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to \frac{\pi}{6}} \frac{2\sin^2 x - 3\sin x + 1}{4\sin^2 x - 1}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។
បំបែកភាគយកនិងភាគបែងជាកត្តា៖

\[\begin{aligned} 2\sin^2 x - 3\sin x + 1 &= (2\sin x - 1)(\sin x - 1)\\ 4\sin^2 x - 1 &= (2\sin x - 1)(2\sin x + 1) \end{aligned}\]
យើងបាន៖
\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to \frac{\pi}{6}} \frac{\sin x - 1}{2\sin x + 1} = \frac{\frac{1}{2} - 1}{2\left(\frac{1}{2}\right) + 1} = -\frac{1}{4} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{1-\cos nx}{1-\cos mx}\) (\(m \neq 0\))៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។
ប្រើរូបមន្ត \(1-\cos u = 2\sin^2\frac{u}{2}\)៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{2\sin^2\frac{nx}{2}}{2\sin^2\frac{mx}{2}}\\ &= \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\left(\frac{\sin(nx/2)}{nx/2}\right)^2 \cdot \frac{n^2 x^2}{4}}{\left(\frac{\sin(mx/2)}{mx/2}\right)^2 \cdot \frac{m^2 x^2}{4}}\\ &= \frac{1^2 \cdot n^2}{1^2 \cdot m^2} = \frac{n^2}{m^2} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{3x + \sin 2x}{3x - \sin 2x}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។
ចែកភាគយកនិងភាគបែងនឹង \(x\)៖

\[\begin{aligned} \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{3x + \sin 2x}{3x - \sin 2x} &= \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{3 + \frac{\sin 2x}{x}}{3 - \frac{\sin 2x}{x}}\\ &= \frac{3 + 2}{3 - 2} = 5 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{(1+x^2) - \cos x}{\tan^2 x}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។
ចែកភាគយកនិងភាគបែងនឹង \(x^2\)៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{1 + \frac{1-\cos x}{x^2}}{\left(\frac{\tan x}{x}\right)^2}\\ &= \frac{1 + \frac{1}{2}}{1^2} = \frac{3}{2} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\sin(a+x) - \sin(a-x)}{x}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។
ប្រើរូបមន្ត \(\sin P - \sin Q = 2\sin\frac{P-Q}{2}\cos\frac{P+Q}{2}\)៖

\[\begin{aligned} \sin(a+x) - \sin(a-x) &= 2\sin x \cos a \end{aligned}\]
យើងបាន៖
\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to 0} \left(2\cos a \cdot \frac{\sin x}{x}\right) = 2\cos a \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\tan x - \sin x}{x}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។

\[\begin{aligned} \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\tan x - \sin x}{x} &= \lim_{x \to 0} \left(\frac{\tan x}{x} - \frac{\sin x}{x}\right)\\ &= 1 - 1 = 0 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{1+\sin x - \cos x}{1-\sin x - \cos x}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។
ប្រើរូបមន្ត \(1-\cos x = 2\sin^2\frac{x}{2}\) និង \(\sin x = 2\sin\frac{x}{2}\cos\frac{x}{2}\)៖

\[\begin{aligned} \text{ភាគយក} &= 2\sin\frac{x}{2}\left(\sin\frac{x}{2} + \cos\frac{x}{2}\right)\\ \text{ភាគបែង} &= 2\sin\frac{x}{2}\left(\sin\frac{x}{2} - \cos\frac{x}{2}\right) \end{aligned}\]
សម្រួលដោយ \(2\sin\frac{x}{2}\)៖
\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\sin\frac{x}{2} + \cos\frac{x}{2}}{\sin\frac{x}{2} - \cos\frac{x}{2}} = \frac{0 + 1}{0 - 1} = -1 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{2\tan x - \sin x}{x}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។

\[\begin{aligned} \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{2\tan x - \sin x}{x} &= \lim_{x \to 0}\left(2\frac{\tan x}{x} - \frac{\sin x}{x}\right)\\ &= 2(1) - 1 = 1 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{x(a-b)}{\sin ax - \sin bx}\) \((a \ne b)\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។ ចែកភាគយកនិងភាគបែងនឹង \(x\)៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{a-b}{\frac{\sin ax}{x} - \frac{\sin bx}{x}}\\ &= \frac{a-b}{a-b} = 1 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\sin(\sin(\sin x))}{x}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to 0} \left(\frac{\sin(\sin(\sin x))}{\sin(\sin x)} \cdot \frac{\sin(\sin x)}{\sin x} \cdot \frac{\sin x}{x}\right)\\ &= 1 \cdot 1 \cdot 1 = 1 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\sin 5x + x\sin 10x}{\sin 10x + x\sin 5x}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។ ចែកភាគយកនិងភាគបែងនឹង \(x\)៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{5\cdot\frac{\sin 5x}{5x} + \sin 10x}{10\cdot\frac{\sin 10x}{10x} + \sin 5x} = \frac{5+0}{10+0} = \frac{1}{2} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{(1-\cos x)\sin x}{\tan^3 x}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to 0} \left(\frac{1-\cos x}{x^2} \cdot \frac{\sin x}{x} \cdot \left(\frac{x}{\tan x}\right)^3\right)\\ &= \frac{1}{2} \cdot 1 \cdot 1^3 = \frac{1}{2} \end{aligned}\]

ដំណោះស្រាយ

ប្រធាន៖ ចូរដោះស្រាយលីមីតខាងក្រោមឲ្យបានត្រឹមត្រូវ៖
. \(\lim_{x \to 1} \frac{\sin(\ln x)}{\ln x}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។
តាង \(t = \ln x \implies x \to 1, t \to 0\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} \lim_{x \to 1} \frac{\sin(\ln x)}{\ln x} &= \lim_{t \to 0} \frac{\sin t}{t} = 1 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to -\infty} \frac{\tan(e^x)}{e^x}\)៖
តាង \(t = e^x\) ។ កាលណា \(x \to -\infty \implies t \to 0^+\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} \lim_{x \to -\infty} \frac{\tan(e^x)}{e^x} &= \lim_{t \to 0^+} \frac{\tan t}{t} = 1 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\sin(x^2)}{x}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។

\[\begin{aligned} \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\sin(x^2)}{x} &= \lim_{x \to 0} \left(\frac{\sin(x^2)}{x^2} \cdot x\right)\\ &= 1 \cdot 0 = 0 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\sin(\sin^2 2x)}{x^2}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to 0} \left(\frac{\sin(\sin^2 2x)}{\sin^2 2x} \cdot \frac{\sin^2 2x}{(2x)^2} \cdot 4\right)\\ &= 1 \cdot 1^2 \cdot 4 = 4 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{1-\cos x}{x^2}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។
ប្រើរូបមន្ត \(1-\cos x = 2\sin^2\frac{x}{2}\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{1-\cos x}{x^2} &= \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{2\sin^2\frac{x}{2}}{x^2}\\ &= \frac{1}{2}\lim_{x \to 0}\left(\frac{\sin\frac{x}{2}}{\frac{x}{2}}\right)^2 = \frac{1}{2} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 1} \frac{\cos(\frac{\pi x}{2})}{1-x}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។
តាង \(t = 1-x \implies x = 1-t\) ។ កាលណា \(x \to 1, t \to 0\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} \cos\left(\frac{\pi(1-t)}{2}\right) &= \cos\left(\frac{\pi}{2} - \frac{\pi t}{2}\right) = \sin\left(\frac{\pi t}{2}\right)\\ \lim_{x \to 1} \frac{\cos(\frac{\pi x}{2})}{1-x} &= \lim_{t \to 0} \frac{\sin(\frac{\pi t}{2})}{t} = \frac{\pi}{2} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to \frac{\pi}{2}} \left(\frac{\pi}{2}-x\right)\tan x\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(0 \cdot \infty\) ។
តាង \(t = \frac{\pi}{2}-x \implies x = \frac{\pi}{2}-t\) ។ ពេល \(x \to \frac{\pi}{2}, t \to 0\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} \tan\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-t\right) &= \cot t = \frac{1}{\tan t}\\ &= \lim_{t \to 0} \frac{t}{\tan t} = 1 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 1} (1-x)\tan\frac{\pi x}{2}\)៖
តាង \(t = 1-x \implies x = 1-t\) ។ ពេល \(x \to 1, t \to 0\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} \tan\left(\frac{\pi(1-t)}{2}\right) &= \cot\left(\frac{\pi t}{2}\right) = \frac{1}{\tan(\frac{\pi t}{2})}\\ &= \lim_{t \to 0} \frac{t}{\tan(\frac{\pi t}{2})} = \frac{2}{\pi} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\sin^{-1} 2x}{3x}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។
តាង \(t = \sin^{-1} 2x \implies 2x = \sin t \implies x = \frac{\sin t}{2}\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\sin^{-1} 2x}{3x} &= \lim_{t \to 0} \frac{t}{3\left(\frac{\sin t}{2}\right)}\\ &= \frac{2}{3}\lim_{t \to 0}\frac{t}{\sin t} = \frac{2}{3} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{x}{\tan^{-1} 2x}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។
តាង \(t = \tan^{-1} 2x \implies 2x = \tan t \implies x = \frac{\tan t}{2}\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{x}{\tan^{-1} 2x} &= \lim_{t \to 0} \frac{\frac{\tan t}{2}}{t}\\ &= \frac{1}{2}\lim_{t \to 0}\frac{\tan t}{t} = \frac{1}{2} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\sin^{-1}(x^2)}{(\tan^{-1} x)^2}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។
ចែកភាគយកនិងភាគបែងនឹង \(x^2\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\frac{\sin^{-1}(x^2)}{x^2}}{\left(\frac{\tan^{-1} x}{x}\right)^2} = \frac{1}{1^2} = 1 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to -3} \frac{x^2-9}{\tan^{-1}(x+3)}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។
តាង \(t = x+3 \implies x = t-3\) ។ ពេល \(x \to -3, t \to 0\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} x^2-9 &= (t-3)^2-9 = t(t-6)\\ &= \lim_{t \to 0} \left(\frac{t}{\tan^{-1} t} \cdot (t-6)\right)\\ &= 1(0-6) = -6 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{2x-\sin^{-1} x}{2x+\tan^{-1} x}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។ ចែកភាគយកនិងភាគបែងនឹង \(x\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{2 - \frac{\sin^{-1} x}{x}}{2 + \frac{\tan^{-1} x}{x}}\\ &= \frac{2-1}{2+1} = \frac{1}{3} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to \frac{\pi}{6}} \frac{\sin(x-\frac{\pi}{6})}{\sqrt{3}-2\cos x}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។
តាង \(t = x-\frac{\pi}{6} \implies x = t + \frac{\pi}{6}\) ។ ពេល \(x \to \frac{\pi}{6}, t \to 0\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} \sqrt{3}-2\cos\left(t+\tfrac{\pi}{6}\right) &= \sqrt{3}(1-\cos t) + \sin t\\ &= \lim_{t \to 0} \frac{\sin t}{\sqrt{3}(1-\cos t) + \sin t}\\ &= \lim_{t \to 0} \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}\frac{1-\cos t}{\sin t} + 1}\\ &= \frac{1}{0+1} = 1 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to \frac{\pi}{4}} \frac{\cos x - \sin x}{(\frac{\pi}{4}-x)(\cos x + \sin x)}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។
តាង \(t = \frac{\pi}{4}-x \implies x = \frac{\pi}{4}-t\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} \cos x - \sin x &= \sqrt{2}\sin t\\ &= \lim_{t \to 0} \frac{\sqrt{2}\sin t}{t(\cos x + \sin x)}\\ &= \sqrt{2}\lim_{t \to 0}\frac{\sin t}{t} \cdot \lim_{x \to \frac{\pi}{4}}\frac{1}{\cos x + \sin x}\\ &= \sqrt{2}(1) \cdot \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}} = 1 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to a} \frac{\cos\sqrt{x} - \cos\sqrt{a}}{x-a}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។
តាមនិយមន័យដេរីវេនៃ \(f(x) = \cos\sqrt{x}\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} f'(x) &= -\frac{\sin\sqrt{x}}{2\sqrt{x}}\\ \lim_{x \to a} \frac{\cos\sqrt{x}-\cos\sqrt{a}}{x-a} &= f'(a) = -\frac{\sin\sqrt{a}}{2\sqrt{a}} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{x(5^x-1)}{1-\cos x}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to 0} \left(\frac{5^x-1}{x} \cdot \frac{x^2}{1-\cos x}\right)\\ &= \ln 5 \cdot \frac{1}{\frac{1}{2}} = 2\ln 5 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{(1-\cos 2x)\sin 5x}{x^2\sin 3x}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to 0} \left(\frac{2\sin^2 x}{x^2} \cdot \frac{\sin 5x}{5x} \cdot \frac{3x}{\sin 3x} \cdot \frac{5}{3}\right)\\ &= 2(1)^2 \cdot 1 \cdot 1 \cdot \frac{5}{3} = \frac{10}{3} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\sin 4x}{1-\sqrt{1-x}}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។ គុណនឹងកន្សោមឆ្លាស់ \(1+\sqrt{1-x}\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\sin 4x(1+\sqrt{1-x})}{1-(1-x)}\\ &= \lim_{x \to 0} \left(\frac{\sin 4x}{x} \cdot (1+\sqrt{1-x})\right)\\ &= 4(1+1) = 8 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\sin x}{\sqrt{x^2}}\)៖
ដោយសារ \(\sqrt{x^2} = |x|\) ៖
\(\bullet\) បើ \(x \to 0^+ \implies |x| = x\) នោះ៖

\[\begin{aligned} \lim_{x \to 0^+} \frac{\sin x}{x} &= 1 \end{aligned}\]
\(\bullet\) បើ \(x \to 0^- \implies |x| = -x\) នោះ៖
\[\begin{aligned} \lim_{x \to 0^-} \frac{\sin x}{-x} &= -1 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\cos x + 4\tan x}{2-x-2x^4}\)៖
ជំនួសតម្លៃ \(x = 0\) ដោយផ្ទាល់៖

\[\begin{aligned} \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\cos x + 4\tan x}{2-x-2x^4} &= \frac{\cos 0 + 4\tan 0}{2 - 0 - 0}\\ &= \frac{1+0}{2} = \frac{1}{2} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\sqrt{x+4}-2}{\sin 5x}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។ គុណនឹងកន្សោមឆ្លាស់ \(\sqrt{x+4}+2\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{(x+4)-4}{\sin 5x(\sqrt{x+4}+2)}\\ &= \lim_{x \to 0} \left(\frac{x}{\sin 5x} \cdot \frac{1}{\sqrt{x+4}+2}\right)\\ &= \frac{1}{5} \cdot \frac{1}{2+2} = \frac{1}{20} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 1} \frac{\sin(1-x)}{\sqrt{x}-1}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។
តាង \(t = 1-x \implies x = 1-t\) ។ ពេល \(x \to 1, t \to 0\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} \sqrt{x}-1 &= \frac{x-1}{\sqrt{x}+1} = \frac{-t}{\sqrt{1-t}+1}\\ &= \lim_{t \to 0} \left(-\frac{\sin t}{t} \cdot (\sqrt{1-t}+1)\right)\\ &= -1 \cdot (1+1) = -2 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{a \to \pi} \frac{\sin a}{1-\frac{a^2}{\pi^2}}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។
តាង \(t = \pi - a \implies a = \pi - t\) ។ ពេល \(a \to \pi, t \to 0\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} \sin a &= \sin(\pi-t) = \sin t\\ 1-\frac{a^2}{\pi^2} &= \frac{(\pi-a)(\pi+a)}{\pi^2} = \frac{t(2\pi-t)}{\pi^2}\\ &= \lim_{t \to 0}\left(\frac{\sin t}{t} \cdot \frac{\pi^2}{2\pi-t}\right)\\ &= 1 \cdot \frac{\pi^2}{2\pi} = \frac{\pi}{2} \end{aligned}\]

ដំណោះស្រាយ

ប្រធាន៖ ចូរដោះស្រាយលីមីតខាងក្រោមឲ្យបានត្រឹមត្រូវ៖
. \(\lim_{x \to +\infty} e^{-x}\)៖

\[\begin{aligned} \lim_{x \to +\infty} e^{-x} &= \lim_{x \to +\infty} \frac{1}{e^x} = 0 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to -\infty} e^{2-3x}\)៖
កាលណា \(x \to -\infty\) នោះ \(2-3x \to +\infty\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} \lim_{x \to -\infty} e^{2-3x} &= +\infty \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to +\infty} (e^x - 7x + 6)\)៖
ទាញ \(e^x\) ជាកត្តារួម៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to +\infty} e^x \left(1 - \frac{7x}{e^x} + \frac{6}{e^x}\right)\\ &= +\infty(1 - 0 + 0) = +\infty \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to -\infty} (e^x + 3)\)៖
កាលណា \(x \to -\infty\) នោះ \(e^x \to 0\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} \lim_{x \to -\infty} (e^x + 3) &= 0 + 3 = 3 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to +\infty} (2e^x - x^2 + 1)\)៖
ទាញ \(e^x\) ជាកត្តារួម៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to +\infty} e^x \left(2 - \frac{x^2}{e^x} + \frac{1}{e^x}\right)\\ &= +\infty(2 - 0 + 0) = +\infty \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} (e^x + 2x^2 - 6)\)៖
ជំនួសតម្លៃ \(x = 0\) ដោយផ្ទាល់៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= e^0 + 2(0)^2 - 6 = 1 - 6 = -5 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to +\infty} (x^3+x)e^{-x}\)៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to +\infty} \frac{x^3+x}{e^x} = \lim_{x \to +\infty} \left(\frac{x^3}{e^x} + \frac{x}{e^x}\right)\\ &= 0 + 0 = 0 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to -\infty} \frac{e^{2x}+1}{e^x+3}\)៖
កាលណា \(x \to -\infty\) នោះ \(e^{2x} \to 0\) និង \(e^x \to 0\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \frac{0 + 1}{0 + 3} = \frac{1}{3} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to +\infty} \frac{xe^x+2}{x^2-1}\)៖
ចែកភាគយកនិងភាគបែងនឹង \(x^2\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to +\infty} \frac{\frac{e^x}{x} + \frac{2}{x^2}}{1 - \frac{1}{x^2}} = \frac{+\infty + 0}{1 - 0} = +\infty \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to -\infty} xe^x\)៖
តាង \(t = -x \implies x = -t\) ។ ពេល \(x \to -\infty, t \to +\infty\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{t \to +\infty} (-t)e^{-t} = \lim_{t \to +\infty} \left(-\frac{t}{e^t}\right) = 0 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to +\infty} \frac{2e^x-1}{x^2+x-3}\)៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to +\infty} \left(\frac{e^x}{x^2} \cdot \frac{2 - \frac{1}{e^x}}{1 + \frac{1}{x} - \frac{3}{x^2}}\right)\\ &= (+\infty) \cdot \frac{2-0}{1+0-0} = +\infty \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to -\infty} (xe^x + e^x + 2)\)៖
ដោយសារ \(\lim_{x \to -\infty} xe^x = 0\) និង \(\lim_{x \to -\infty} e^x = 0\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= 0 + 0 + 2 = 2 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to +\infty} \frac{x^3-e^x}{2e^x+3x+1}\)៖
ចែកភាគយកនិងភាគបែងនឹង \(e^x\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to +\infty} \frac{\frac{x^3}{e^x} - 1}{2 + \frac{3x}{e^x} + \frac{1}{e^x}} = \frac{0 - 1}{2 + 0 + 0} = -\frac{1}{2} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to +\infty} \frac{x-e^x}{2e^x+3}\)៖
ចែកភាគយកនិងភាគបែងនឹង \(e^x\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to +\infty} \frac{\frac{x}{e^x} - 1}{2 + \frac{3}{e^x}} = \frac{0-1}{2+0} = -\frac{1}{2} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to -\infty} \frac{e^x-e^{-x}}{e^x+e^{-x}}\)៖
កាលណា \(x \to -\infty \implies e^x \to 0, e^{-x} \to +\infty\) ៖
ចែកភាគយកនិងភាគបែងនឹង \(e^{-x}\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to -\infty} \frac{e^{2x}-1}{e^{2x}+1} = \frac{0-1}{0+1} = -1 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to +\infty} \frac{3e^{x-2}}{x^3}\)៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \frac{3}{e^2}\lim_{x \to +\infty} \frac{e^x}{x^3} = \frac{3}{e^2}(+\infty) = +\infty \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to +\infty} (x+1)e^{-x}\)៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to +\infty} \frac{x+1}{e^x} = \lim_{x \to +\infty} \left(\frac{x}{e^x} + \frac{1}{e^x}\right)\\ &= 0 + 0 = 0 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{e^{2x}-e^{-2x}}{x}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(\frac{0}{0}\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to 0} \left(\frac{e^{2x}-1}{x} - \frac{e^{-2x}-1}{x}\right)\\ &= 2(1) - (-2)(1) = 4 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{e^x+e^{-x}-2}{x^2}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។ គុណនឹង \(e^x\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{e^{2x}-2e^x+1}{x^2 e^x} = \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{(e^x-1)^2}{x^2 e^x}\\ &= \lim_{x \to 0} \left(\frac{e^x-1}{x}\right)^2 \cdot \frac{1}{e^x} = 1^2 \cdot 1 = 1 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{2e^{2x}-3e^x+1}{x}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។ បំបែកជាកត្តា៖
\(2(e^x)^2 - 3e^x + 1 = (2e^x - 1)(e^x - 1)\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to 0} \left((2e^x - 1) \cdot \frac{e^x-1}{x}\right)\\ &= (2(1)-1) \cdot 1 = 1 \end{aligned}\]

ដំណោះស្រាយ

ប្រធាន៖ ចូរដោះស្រាយលីមីតខាងក្រោមឲ្យបានត្រឹមត្រូវ៖
. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{e^x+\sin x - 1}{x}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(\frac{0}{0}\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to 0} \left(\frac{e^x-1}{x} + \frac{\sin x}{x}\right)\\ &= 1 + 1 = 2 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{e^{2x}-1}{e^{3x}-1}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(\frac{0}{0}\) ៖
ចែកភាគយក និងភាគបែងនឹង \(x\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\frac{e^{2x}-1}{x}}{\frac{e^{3x}-1}{x}} = \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{2 \cdot \frac{e^{2x}-1}{2x}}{3 \cdot \frac{e^{3x}-1}{3x}}\\ &= \frac{2(1)}{3(1)} = \frac{2}{3} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{e^{\sin x}+\sin 2x - 1}{\sin x}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(\frac{0}{0}\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to 0} \left(\frac{e^{\sin x}-1}{\sin x} + \frac{\sin 2x}{\sin x}\right)\\ &= \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{e^{\sin x}-1}{\sin x} + \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{2\sin x \cos x}{\sin x}\\ &= 1 + 2\lim_{x \to 0} \cos x = 1 + 2(1) = 3 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{(e^{-3x+2}-e^2)\sin \pi x}{4x^2}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(\frac{0}{0}\) ៖
ទាញ \(e^2\) ជាកត្តា ៖ \(e^{-3x+2}-e^2 = e^2(e^{-3x}-1)\)

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to 0} \left[\frac{e^2(e^{-3x}-1)}{x} \cdot \frac{\sin \pi x}{4x}\right]\\ &= \lim_{x \to 0} \left[-3e^2 \cdot \frac{e^{-3x}-1}{-3x} \cdot \frac{\pi}{4} \cdot \frac{\sin \pi x}{\pi x}\right]\\ &= -3e^2(1) \cdot \frac{\pi}{4}(1) = -\frac{3\pi e^2}{4} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\sin x + e^x - 1}{x^2+x}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(\frac{0}{0}\) ៖
ភាគបែង \(x^2+x = x(x+1)\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to 0} \left[\frac{1}{x+1} \left(\frac{\sin x}{x} + \frac{e^x-1}{x}\right)\right]\\ &= \frac{1}{0+1} \cdot (1 + 1) = 2 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 1} \frac{1-x}{e^x-e}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(\frac{0}{0}\) ៖
ទាញ \(e\) ជាកត្តា ៖ \(e^x - e = e(e^{x-1}-1)\) ៖
តាង \(t = x-1 \implies x = t+1\) ។
កាលណា \(x \to 1 \implies t \to 0\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{t \to 0} \frac{-t}{e(e^t-1)} = -\frac{1}{e}\lim_{t \to 0} \frac{1}{\frac{e^t-1}{t}}\\ &= -\frac{1}{e} \cdot \frac{1}{1} = -\frac{1}{e} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{5^x-4^x}{x^2-x}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(\frac{0}{0}\) ៖
ថែម និងដក \(1\) នៅភាគយក ៖
\(5^x-4^x = (5^x-1) - (4^x-1)\)
ភាគបែង \(x^2-x = x(x-1)\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to 0} \left[\frac{1}{x-1} \left(\frac{5^x-1}{x} - \frac{4^x-1}{x}\right)\right]\\ &= \frac{1}{0-1} \cdot (\ln 5 - \ln 4)\\ &= -(\ln 5 - \ln 4) = -\ln\frac{5}{4} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{2-(e^x+e^{-x})}{x^2}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(\frac{0}{0}\) ៖
គុណភាគយក និងភាគបែងនឹង \(e^x\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{2e^x - e^{2x} - 1}{x^2 e^x} = \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{-(e^x-1)^2}{x^2 e^x}\\ &= \lim_{x \to 0} \left[-\left(\frac{e^x-1}{x}\right)^2 \cdot \frac{1}{e^x}\right]\\ &= -(1)^2 \cdot \frac{1}{e^0} = -1 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{e^{\sin x}-e^{\sin 3x}}{\sin 2x}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(\frac{0}{0}\) ៖
ចែកភាគយក និងភាគបែងនឹង \(x\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\frac{e^{\sin x}-1}{\sin x}\cdot\frac{\sin x}{x} - \frac{e^{\sin 3x}-1}{\sin 3x}\cdot\frac{\sin 3x}{x}}{\frac{\sin 2x}{x}}\\ &= \frac{1(1) - 1(3)}{2} = \frac{-2}{2} = -1 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{e^{ax}-e^{bx}}{x}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(\frac{0}{0}\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to 0} \left(\frac{e^{ax}-1}{x} - \frac{e^{bx}-1}{x}\right)\\ &= \lim_{x \to 0} \left(a\cdot\frac{e^{ax}-1}{ax} - b\cdot\frac{e^{bx}-1}{bx}\right)\\ &= a(1) - b(1) = a - b \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{e^{\sin^2 2x}-\cos(\sin 3x)}{x^2}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(\frac{0}{0}\) ៖
ថែម និងដក \(1\) នៅភាគយក ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to 0} \left[\frac{e^{\sin^2 2x}-1}{x^2} + \frac{1-\cos(\sin 3x)}{x^2}\right] \end{aligned}\]
\(\bullet\) តួទី១៖
\[\begin{aligned} \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{e^{\sin^2 2x}-1}{\sin^2 2x} \cdot \frac{\sin^2 2x}{(2x)^2} \cdot 4 &= 1 \cdot 1^2 \cdot 4 = 4 \end{aligned}\]
\(\bullet\) តួទី២៖ ដោយ \(1-\cos u = 2\sin^2\frac{u}{2}\)
\[\begin{aligned} \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{2\sin^2\left(\frac{\sin 3x}{2}\right)}{x^2} &= \lim_{x \to 0} 2\left(\frac{\sin\frac{\sin 3x}{2}}{\frac{\sin 3x}{2}}\right)^2 \cdot \frac{\sin^2 3x}{4x^2}\\ &= 2(1)^2 \cdot \frac{9}{4}(1)^2 = \frac{9}{2} \end{aligned}\]
សរុប៖ \(4 + \frac{9}{2} = \frac{17}{2}\)

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{e^{x^2}-\cos x}{x^2}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(\frac{0}{0}\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to 0} \left(\frac{e^{x^2}-1}{x^2} + \frac{1-\cos x}{x^2}\right)\\ &= 1 + \frac{1}{2} = \frac{3}{2} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{e^{x+1}-e}{\sin \pi x}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(\frac{0}{0}\) ៖
ទាញ \(e\) ជាកត្តា ៖ \(e^{x+1}-e = e(e^x-1)\)

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{e(e^x-1)}{\sin \pi x} = \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{e \cdot \frac{e^x-1}{x}}{\pi \cdot \frac{\sin \pi x}{\pi x}}\\ &= \frac{e(1)}{\pi(1)} = \frac{e}{\pi} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to \pi} \frac{\sin 2x}{e^{x+\pi}-e^{2\pi}}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(\frac{0}{0}\) ៖
តាង \(t = x-\pi \implies x = t+\pi\) ។
កាលណា \(x \to \pi \implies t \to 0\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} \sin 2x &= \sin(2t+2\pi) = \sin 2t\\ e^{x+\pi}-e^{2\pi} &= e^{2\pi}(e^t-1) \end{aligned}\]
\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{t \to 0} \frac{\sin 2t}{e^{2\pi}(e^t-1)} = \frac{1}{e^{2\pi}}\lim_{t \to 0} \frac{2\cdot\frac{\sin 2t}{2t}}{\frac{e^t-1}{t}}\\ &= \frac{1}{e^{2\pi}} \cdot \frac{2(1)}{1} = \frac{2}{e^{2\pi}} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{e^x+\sin x - 1}{1-\sqrt{x+1}}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(\frac{0}{0}\) ៖
គុណកន្សោមឆ្លាស់ \((1+\sqrt{x+1})\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{(e^x-1+\sin x)(1+\sqrt{x+1})}{1-(x+1)}\\ &= \lim_{x \to 0} \left[-\left(\frac{e^x-1}{x} + \frac{\sin x}{x}\right)(1+\sqrt{x+1})\right]\\ &= -(1 + 1)(1 + 1) = -4 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{(e^x-1)(1-\cos 2x)\sin 7x}{x^4}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(\frac{0}{0}\) ៖
ដោយ \(1-\cos 2x = 2\sin^2 x\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to 0} \left[\frac{e^x-1}{x} \cdot \frac{2\sin^2 x}{x^2} \cdot \frac{\sin 7x}{x}\right]\\ &= \lim_{x \to 0} \left[\frac{e^x-1}{x} \cdot 2\left(\frac{\sin x}{x}\right)^2 \cdot 7 \cdot \frac{\sin 7x}{7x}\right]\\ &= 1 \cdot 2(1)^2 \cdot 7(1) = 14 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{x^2}{e^{x^2}-4^{x^2}}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(\frac{0}{0}\) ៖
ចែកភាគយក និងភាគបែងនឹង \(x^2\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{1}{\frac{e^{x^2}-4^{x^2}}{x^2}} = \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{1}{\frac{e^{x^2}-1}{x^2} - \frac{4^{x^2}-1}{x^2}}\\ &= \frac{1}{1 - \ln 4} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{e^x-e^{-x}}{\sin 2x}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(\frac{0}{0}\) ៖
ចែកភាគយក និងភាគបែងនឹង \(x\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\frac{e^x-1}{x} - \frac{e^{-x}-1}{x}}{\frac{\sin 2x}{x}}\\ &= \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\frac{e^x-1}{x} + \frac{e^{-x}-1}{-x}}{2 \cdot \frac{\sin 2x}{2x}}\\ &= \frac{1 + 1}{2(1)} = 1 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{2e^{x}+3e^{2x}-5}{e^{3x}-1}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។ សរសេរ \(2e^x+3e^{2x}-5 = 2(e^x-1)+3(e^{2x}-1)\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{2\cdot\frac{e^{x}-1}{x} + 6 \cdot \frac{e^{2x}-1}{2x}}{3 \cdot \frac{e^{3x}-1}{3x}}\\ &= \frac{2(1)+6(1)}{3(1)} = \frac{8}{3} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{e^{-x^2}-\cos 2x}{x^2}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(\frac{0}{0}\) ៖
ថែម និងដក \(1\) នៅភាគយក ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to 0} \left(\frac{e^{-x^2}-1}{x^2} + \frac{1-\cos 2x}{x^2}\right)\\ &= \lim_{x \to 0} \left(-\frac{e^{-x^2}-1}{-x^2} + \frac{2\sin^2 x}{x^2}\right)\\ &= -1 + 2(1)^2 = 1 \end{aligned}\]

ដំណោះស្រាយ

ប្រធាន៖ ចូរដោះស្រាយលីមីតខាងក្រោមឲ្យបានត្រឹមត្រូវ៖
. \(\lim_{x \to +\infty} \frac{\ln x}{x^2-x}\)៖
ទាញ \(x^2\) ជាកត្តានៅភាគបែង ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to +\infty} \left[\frac{\ln x}{x} \cdot \frac{1}{x-1}\right]\\ &= 0 \cdot 0 = 0 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to -\infty} \ln(e^x+1)\)៖
កាលណា \(x \to -\infty \implies e^x \to 0\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \ln(0+1) = \ln 1 = 0 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0^+} \ln\left(\frac{x}{x+1}\right)\)៖
កាលណា \(x \to 0^+ \implies \frac{x}{x+1} \to 0^+\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} \text{តាង } u &= \frac{x}{x+1} \to 0^+\\ &= \lim_{u \to 0^+} \ln u = -\infty \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to +\infty} x\ln(x^2+1)\)៖
កាលណា \(x \to +\infty\) ៖
\(x \to +\infty\) និង \(\ln(x^2+1) \to +\infty\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= (+\infty)(+\infty) = +\infty \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to +\infty} (x\ln x - x^2 + 5)\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(\infty - \infty\) ៖
ទាញ \(x^2\) ជាកត្តា ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to +\infty} x^2 \left(\frac{\ln x}{x} - 1 + \frac{5}{x^2}\right)\\ &= (+\infty)(0 - 1 + 0) = -\infty \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 1^-} x\ln(4-3x-x^2)\)៖
ជំនួស \(x \to 1^-\) ចូល ៖
\(4 - 3(1) - (1)^2 = 0^+\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= 1 \cdot \ln(0^+) = 1 \cdot (-\infty) = -\infty \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to +\infty} x[\ln(x+1)-\ln x]\)៖
ប្រើលក្ខណៈ \(\ln A - \ln B = \ln\frac{A}{B}\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to +\infty} x\ln\left(\frac{x+1}{x}\right) = \lim_{x \to +\infty} x\ln\left(1+\frac{1}{x}\right) \end{aligned}\]
តាង \(t = \frac{1}{x} \implies x = \frac{1}{t}\) ។ កាលណា \(x \to +\infty \implies t \to 0^+\) ៖
\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{t \to 0^+} \frac{\ln(1+t)}{t} = 1 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0^+} (x\ln x - x^2 + 2)\)៖
ដោយតាមរូបមន្តគ្រឹះ \(\lim_{x \to 0^+} x\ln x = 0\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= 0 - 0^2 + 2 = 2 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0^+} \frac{x^2\ln x + 2}{\ln x + 1}\)៖
ចែកភាគយក និងភាគបែងនឹង \(\ln x\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to 0^+} \frac{x^2 + \frac{2}{\ln x}}{1 + \frac{1}{\ln x}} = \frac{0 + 0}{1 + 0} = 0 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0^+} \left(\frac{1}{x} - \frac{\ln x}{x}\right)\)៖
តម្រូវភាគបែងរួម ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to 0^+} \frac{1-\ln x}{x} \end{aligned}\]
ដោយកាលណា \(x \to 0^+ \implies 1-\ln x \to +\infty\) ៖
\[\begin{aligned} &= \frac{+\infty}{0^+} = +\infty \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to +\infty} \frac{e^x\ln x + 1}{x^2}\)៖
បំបែកជាពីរតួ ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to +\infty} \left(\frac{e^x\ln x}{x^2} + \frac{1}{x^2}\right)\\ &= \lim_{x \to +\infty} \left(\frac{e^x}{x^2}\cdot\ln x + \frac{1}{x^2}\right)\\ &= (+\infty)(+\infty) + 0 = +\infty \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\ln(1+x)}{1-e^x}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(\frac{0}{0}\) ៖
ចែកភាគយក និងភាគបែងនឹង \(x\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\frac{\ln(1+x)}{x}}{-\frac{e^x-1}{x}} = \frac{1}{-1} = -1 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 1} \frac{x^2-1+\ln x}{e^x-e}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(\frac{0}{0}\) ៖
តាង \(t = x-1 \implies x = t+1\) ។
កាលណា \(x \to 1 \implies t \to 0\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{t \to 0} \frac{(t+1)^2-1+\ln(1+t)}{e^{t+1}-e}\\ &= \lim_{t \to 0} \frac{t^2+2t+\ln(1+t)}{e(e^t-1)}\\ &= \lim_{t \to 0} \frac{t+2+\frac{\ln(1+t)}{t}}{e\cdot\frac{e^t-1}{t}} = \frac{0+2+1}{e(1)} = \frac{3}{e} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to +\infty} [x+3-3\ln(e^x+1)]\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(\infty - \infty\) ៖
ទាញ \(e^x\) ជាកត្តាក្នុងលោការីត ៖
\(\ln(e^x+1) = \ln[e^x(1+e^{-x})] = x + \ln(1+e^{-x})\)

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to +\infty} [x+3-3(x+\ln(1+e^{-x}))]\\ &= \lim_{x \to +\infty} [-2x+3-3\ln(1+e^{-x})]\\ &= -\infty + 3 - 0 = -\infty \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\ln(1+x)}{e^{2x}-1}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(\frac{0}{0}\) ៖
ចែកភាគយក និងភាគបែងនឹង \(x\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\frac{\ln(1+x)}{x}}{2\cdot\frac{e^{2x}-1}{2x}} = \frac{1}{2(1)} = \frac{1}{2} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to +\infty} \left(x+\frac{\ln x}{2x+1}\right)\)៖
គណនាលីមីតតួទីពីរ ៖

\[\begin{aligned} \lim_{x \to +\infty} \frac{\ln x}{2x+1} &= \lim_{x \to +\infty} \frac{\frac{\ln x}{x}}{2+\frac{1}{x}} = \frac{0}{2+0} = 0 \end{aligned}\]
លីមីតសរុបស្មើ ៖
\[\begin{aligned} &= +\infty + 0 = +\infty \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\ln(1+2x^2)}{1-\cos 2x}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(\frac{0}{0}\) ៖
ដោយ \(1-\cos 2x = 2\sin^2 x\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to 0} \left[\frac{\ln(1+2x^2)}{2x^2} \cdot \frac{2x^2}{2\sin^2 x}\right]\\ &= \lim_{x \to 0} \left[\frac{\ln(1+2x^2)}{2x^2} \cdot \left(\frac{x}{\sin x}\right)^2\right]\\ &= 1 \cdot 1^2 = 1 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\ln(\cos 2x)}{x^2}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(\frac{0}{0}\) ៖
សរសេរ \(\cos 2x = 1+(\cos 2x - 1)\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to 0} \left[\frac{\ln(1+(\cos 2x - 1))}{\cos 2x - 1} \cdot \frac{\cos 2x - 1}{x^2}\right]\\ &= \lim_{x \to 0} \left[\frac{\ln(1+(\cos 2x - 1))}{\cos 2x - 1} \cdot \frac{-2\sin^2 x}{x^2}\right]\\ &= 1 \cdot (-2(1)^2) = -2 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\ln(x^2-x+1)}{x}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(\frac{0}{0}\) ៖
សរសេរ \(x^2-x+1 = 1 + (x^2-x)\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to 0} \left[\frac{\ln(1+(x^2-x))}{x^2-x} \cdot \frac{x^2-x}{x}\right]\\ &= \lim_{x \to 0} \left[\frac{\ln(1+(x^2-x))}{x^2-x} \cdot (x-1)\right]\\ &= 1 \cdot (0-1) = -1 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\ln(1+x)+\ln(1+2x)}{x}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(\frac{0}{0}\) ៖
បំបែកជាពីរតួ ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to 0} \left(\frac{\ln(1+x)}{x} + \frac{\ln(1+2x)}{x}\right)\\ &= \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\ln(1+x)}{x} + \lim_{x \to 0} 2\cdot\frac{\ln(1+2x)}{2x}\\ &= 1 + 2(1) = 3 \end{aligned}\]

ដំណោះស្រាយ

ប្រធាន៖ ចូរដោះស្រាយលីមីតខាងក្រោមឲ្យបានត្រឹមត្រូវ៖
. \(\lim_{n \to +\infty} \left(\frac{1+n}{n}\right)^{n+2020}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(1^\infty\) ៖
បំបែកជាផលគុណ ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{n \to +\infty} \left(1 + \frac{1}{n}\right)^{n+2020}\\ &= \lim_{n \to +\infty} \left[\left(1 + \frac{1}{n}\right)^n \cdot \left(1 + \frac{1}{n}\right)^{2020}\right]\\ &= e \cdot (1+0)^{2020} = e \cdot 1 = e \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to +\infty} \left(\frac{2x+3}{2x+1}\right)^{x+1}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(1^\infty\) ៖
បំបែក \(\frac{2x+3}{2x+1} = 1 + \frac{2}{2x+1}\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to +\infty} \left[\left(1 + \frac{2}{2x+1}\right)^{\frac{2x+1}{2}}\right]^{\frac{2(x+1)}{2x+1}} \end{aligned}\]
ដោយ \(\lim_{x \to +\infty} \frac{2x+2}{2x+1} = 1\) នាំឱ្យ ៖
\[\begin{aligned} &= e^1 = e \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to +\infty} \left(1+\frac{1}{x}\right)^{\frac{x+1}{x}}\)៖
កាលណា \(x \to +\infty\) ៖
មូលដ្ឋាន \(1+\frac{1}{x} \to 1+0 = 1\)
ស្វ័យគុណ \(\frac{x+1}{x} = 1+\frac{1}{x} \to 1+0 = 1\) ៖
ជារាងកំណត់ \(1^1\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= 1^1 = 1 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to \infty} \left(1+\frac{1}{x}\right)^{3x}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(1^\infty\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to \infty} \left[\left(1+\frac{1}{x}\right)^x\right]^3 = e^3 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to \infty} \left(1+\frac{1}{x^2}\right)^{3x-4}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(1^\infty\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to \infty} \left[\left(1+\frac{1}{x^2}\right)^{x^2}\right]^{\frac{3x-4}{x^2}} \end{aligned}\]
ដោយ \(\lim_{x \to \infty} \frac{3x-4}{x^2} = 0\) នាំឱ្យ ៖
\[\begin{aligned} &= e^0 = 1 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to \infty} \left(1+\frac{1}{5x}\right)^{2x+6}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(1^\infty\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to \infty} \left[\left(1+\frac{1}{5x}\right)^{5x}\right]^{\frac{2x+6}{5x}} \end{aligned}\]
ដោយ \(\lim_{x \to \infty} \frac{2x+6}{5x} = \frac{2}{5}\) នាំឱ្យ ៖
\[\begin{aligned} &= e^{2/5} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to \infty} \left(1+\frac{7}{3x}\right)^{x-1}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(1^\infty\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to \infty} \left[\left(1+\frac{7}{3x}\right)^{\frac{3x}{7}}\right]^{\frac{7(x-1)}{3x}} \end{aligned}\]
ដោយ \(\lim_{x \to \infty} \frac{7x-7}{3x} = \frac{7}{3}\) នាំឱ្យ ៖
\[\begin{aligned} &= e^{7/3} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to \infty} \left(1-\frac{1}{3x}\right)^x\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(1^\infty\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to \infty} \left[\left(1+\frac{-1}{3x}\right)^{-3x}\right]^{-\frac{1}{3}} = e^{-1/3} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to \infty} \left(1-\frac{5}{x}\right)^x\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(1^\infty\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to \infty} \left[\left(1+\frac{-5}{x}\right)^{-\frac{x}{5}}\right]^{-5} = e^{-5} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to \infty} \left(\frac{x-1}{x+1}\right)^x\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(1^\infty\) ៖
បំបែក \(\frac{x-1}{x+1} = 1 - \frac{2}{x+1}\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to \infty} \left[\left(1+\frac{-2}{x+1}\right)^{-\frac{x+1}{2}}\right]^{\frac{-2x}{x+1}} \end{aligned}\]
ដោយ \(\lim_{x \to \infty} \frac{-2x}{x+1} = -2\) នាំឱ្យ ៖
\[\begin{aligned} &= e^{-2} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to \infty} \left(\frac{x+6}{x+5}\right)^x\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(1^\infty\) ៖
បំបែក \(\frac{x+6}{x+5} = 1 + \frac{1}{x+5}\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to \infty} \left[\left(1+\frac{1}{x+5}\right)^{x+5}\right]^{\frac{x}{x+5}} \end{aligned}\]
ដោយ \(\lim_{x \to \infty} \frac{x}{x+5} = 1\) នាំឱ្យ ៖
\[\begin{aligned} &= e^1 = e \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to \infty} \left(\frac{x-3}{x}\right)^{\frac{x}{2}}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(1^\infty\) ៖
បំបែក \(\frac{x-3}{x} = 1 - \frac{3}{x}\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to \infty} \left[\left(1+\frac{-3}{x}\right)^{-\frac{x}{3}}\right]^{-\frac{3}{x}\cdot\frac{x}{2}}\\ &= e^{-3/2} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to \infty} \left(\frac{7x+10}{1+7x}\right)^{\frac{x}{3}}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(1^\infty\) ៖
បំបែក \(\frac{7x+10}{7x+1} = 1 + \frac{9}{7x+1}\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to \infty} \left[\left(1+\frac{9}{7x+1}\right)^{\frac{7x+1}{9}}\right]^{\frac{9}{7x+1}\cdot\frac{x}{3}} \end{aligned}\]
ដោយ \(\lim_{x \to \infty} \frac{3x}{7x+1} = \frac{3}{7}\) នាំឱ្យ ៖
\[\begin{aligned} &= e^{3/7} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to \infty} \left(\frac{2x-1}{2x+1}\right)^x\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(1^\infty\) ៖
បំបែក \(\frac{2x-1}{2x+1} = 1 - \frac{2}{2x+1}\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to \infty} \left[\left(1+\frac{-2}{2x+1}\right)^{-\frac{2x+1}{2}}\right]^{\frac{-2x}{2x+1}} \end{aligned}\]
ដោយ \(\lim_{x \to \infty} \frac{-2x}{2x+1} = -1\) នាំឱ្យ ៖
\[\begin{aligned} &= e^{-1} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to \infty} \left(\frac{6+4x}{2+4x}\right)^{3-2x}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(1^\infty\) ៖
បំបែក \(\frac{4x+6}{4x+2} = 1 + \frac{4}{4x+2}\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to \infty} \left[\left(1+\frac{4}{4x+2}\right)^{\frac{4x+2}{4}}\right]^{\frac{4(3-2x)}{4x+2}} \end{aligned}\]
ដោយ \(\lim_{x \to \infty} \frac{12-8x}{4x+2} = -2\) នាំឱ្យ ៖
\[\begin{aligned} &= e^{-2} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to \infty} \left(\frac{x+5}{x+4}\right)^{2x-1}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(1^\infty\) ៖
បំបែក \(\frac{x+5}{x+4} = 1 + \frac{1}{x+4}\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to \infty} \left[\left(1+\frac{1}{x+4}\right)^{x+4}\right]^{\frac{2x-1}{x+4}} \end{aligned}\]
ដោយ \(\lim_{x \to \infty} \frac{2x-1}{x+4} = 2\) នាំឱ្យ ៖
\[\begin{aligned} &= e^2 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to \infty} \left(\frac{2x+5}{2x}\right)^{3x-7}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(1^\infty\) ៖
បំបែក \(\frac{2x+5}{2x} = 1 + \frac{5}{2x}\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to \infty} \left[\left(1+\frac{5}{2x}\right)^{\frac{2x}{5}}\right]^{\frac{5(3x-7)}{2x}} \end{aligned}\]
ដោយ \(\lim_{x \to \infty} \frac{15x-35}{2x} = \frac{15}{2}\) នាំឱ្យ ៖
\[\begin{aligned} &= e^{15/2} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to \infty} \left(\frac{2x+1}{2x-3}\right)^{3x}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(1^\infty\) ៖
បំបែក \(\frac{2x+1}{2x-3} = 1 + \frac{4}{2x-3}\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to \infty} \left[\left(1+\frac{4}{2x-3}\right)^{\frac{2x-3}{4}}\right]^{\frac{12x}{2x-3}} \end{aligned}\]
ដោយ \(\lim_{x \to \infty} \frac{12x}{2x-3} = 6\) នាំឱ្យ ៖
\[\begin{aligned} &= e^6 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to \infty} \left(\frac{x-1}{x+3}\right)^{5-4x}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(1^\infty\) ៖
បំបែក \(\frac{x-1}{x+3} = 1 - \frac{4}{x+3}\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to \infty} \left[\left(1+\frac{-4}{x+3}\right)^{-\frac{x+3}{4}}\right]^{\frac{-4(5-4x)}{x+3}} \end{aligned}\]
ដោយ \(\lim_{x \to \infty} \frac{16x-20}{x+3} = 16\) នាំឱ្យ ៖
\[\begin{aligned} &= e^{16} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to \infty} \left(\frac{x}{x+1}\right)^x\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(1^\infty\) ៖
បំបែក \(\frac{x}{x+1} = 1 - \frac{1}{x+1}\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to \infty} \left[\left(1+\frac{-1}{x+1}\right)^{-(x+1)}\right]^{-\frac{x}{x+1}} \end{aligned}\]
ដោយ \(\lim_{x \to \infty} -\frac{x}{x+1} = -1\) នាំឱ្យ ៖
\[\begin{aligned} &= e^{-1} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to \infty} \left(\frac{3x-2}{3x+1}\right)^{2x}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(1^\infty\) ៖
បំបែក \(\frac{3x-2}{3x+1} = 1 - \frac{3}{3x+1}\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to \infty} \left[\left(1+\frac{-3}{3x+1}\right)^{-\frac{3x+1}{3}}\right]^{\frac{-6x}{3x+1}} \end{aligned}\]
ដោយ \(\lim_{x \to \infty} \frac{-6x}{3x+1} = -2\) នាំឱ្យ ៖
\[\begin{aligned} &= e^{-2} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to +\infty} \left(\frac{2x-5}{2x-2}\right)^{4x^2}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(1^\infty\) ៖
បំបែក \(\frac{2x-5}{2x-2} = 1 - \frac{3}{2x-2}\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to +\infty} \left[\left(1+\frac{-3}{2x-2}\right)^{-\frac{2x-2}{3}}\right]^{\frac{-12x^2}{2x-2}} \end{aligned}\]
ដោយ \(\lim_{x \to +\infty} \frac{-12x^2}{2x-2} = -\infty\) នាំឱ្យ ៖
\[\begin{aligned} &= e^{-\infty} = 0 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to +\infty} \left(\frac{3x+6}{3x-1}\right)^{x^2}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(1^\infty\) ៖
បំបែក \(\frac{3x+6}{3x-1} = 1 + \frac{7}{3x-1}\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to +\infty} \left[\left(1+\frac{7}{3x-1}\right)^{\frac{3x-1}{7}}\right]^{\frac{7x^2}{3x-1}} \end{aligned}\]
ដោយ \(\lim_{x \to +\infty} \frac{7x^2}{3x-1} = +\infty\) នាំឱ្យ ៖
\[\begin{aligned} &= e^{+\infty} = +\infty \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to \infty} \left(\frac{x^2+2x+1}{x^2+3}\right)^x\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(1^\infty\) ៖
បំបែក \(\frac{x^2+2x+1}{x^2+3} = 1 + \frac{2x-2}{x^2+3}\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to \infty} \left[\left(1+\frac{2x-2}{x^2+3}\right)^{\frac{x^2+3}{2x-2}}\right]^{\frac{(2x-2)x}{x^2+3}} \end{aligned}\]
ដោយ \(\lim_{x \to \infty} \frac{2x^2-2x}{x^2+3} = 2\) នាំឱ្យ ៖
\[\begin{aligned} &= e^2 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} (1+2x)^{\frac{1}{x}}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(1^\infty\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to 0} \left[(1+2x)^{\frac{1}{2x}}\right]^2 = e^2 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} (1+5x)^{\frac{1}{8x}}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(1^\infty\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to 0} \left[(1+5x)^{\frac{1}{5x}}\right]^{\frac{5}{8}} = e^{5/8} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to \infty} \left[\ln\left(\frac{3x+1}{3x-5}\right)^{2-x}\right]\)៖
គណនាលីមីតខាងក្នុង ៖

\[\begin{aligned} \lim_{x \to \infty} \left(\frac{3x+1}{3x-5}\right)^{2-x} &= \lim_{x \to \infty} \left(1+\frac{6}{3x-5}\right)^{2-x}\\ &= e^{\lim_{x \to \infty} \frac{6(2-x)}{3x-5}} = e^{-2} \end{aligned}\]
លីមីតសរុបស្មើ ៖
\[\begin{aligned} &= \ln(e^{-2}) = -2 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to \infty} x[\ln(x+3)-\ln x]\)៖
ប្រើលក្ខណៈលោការីត ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to \infty} \ln\left(\frac{x+3}{x}\right)^x = \ln\left[\lim_{x \to \infty} \left(1+\frac{3}{x}\right)^x\right]\\ &= \ln(e^3) = 3 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to +\infty} x[\ln x - \ln(x+2)]\)៖
ប្រើលក្ខណៈលោការីត ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to +\infty} \ln\left(\frac{x}{x+2}\right)^x = \ln\left[\lim_{x \to +\infty} \left(1-\frac{2}{x+2}\right)^x\right]\\ &= \ln(e^{-2}) = -2 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to \infty} (x+1)[\ln(x+1)-\ln x]\)៖
ប្រើលក្ខណៈលោការីត ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to \infty} \ln\left(\frac{x+1}{x}\right)^{x+1}\\ &= \ln\left[\lim_{x \to \infty} \left(1+\frac{1}{x}\right)^x \cdot \left(1+\frac{1}{x}\right)\right]\\ &= \ln(e \cdot 1) = \ln e = 1 \end{aligned}\]

ដំណោះស្រាយ

ប្រធាន៖ ចូរដោះស្រាយលីមីតខាងក្រោមឲ្យបានត្រឹមត្រូវ៖
. \(\lim_{x \to 0^+} (1+2x)^{\cot x}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(1^\infty\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to 0^+} \left[(1+2x)^{\frac{1}{2x}}\right]^{2x\cot x} \end{aligned}\]
ដោយ \(\lim_{x \to 0^+} 2x\cot x = \lim_{x \to 0^+} \frac{2x\cos x}{\sin x} = 2\) នាំឱ្យ ៖
\[\begin{aligned} &= e^2 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} (1+\sin x)^{\frac{1}{x}}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(1^\infty\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to 0} \left[(1+\sin x)^{\frac{1}{\sin x}}\right]^{\frac{\sin x}{x}} \end{aligned}\]
ដោយ \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\sin x}{x} = 1\) នាំឱ្យ ៖
\[\begin{aligned} &= e^1 = e \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} (2-e^x)^{\frac{1}{x}}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(1^\infty\) ៖
បំបែក \(2-e^x = 1+(1-e^x)\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to 0} \left[(1+(1-e^x))^{\frac{1}{1-e^x}}\right]^{\frac{1-e^x}{x}} \end{aligned}\]
ដោយ \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{1-e^x}{x} = -1\) នាំឱ្យ ៖
\[\begin{aligned} &= e^{-1} = \frac{1}{e} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} (1+\sin x)^{\cot x}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(1^\infty\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to 0} \left[(1+\sin x)^{\frac{1}{\sin x}}\right]^{\sin x\cot x} \end{aligned}\]
ដោយ \(\sin x\cot x = \cos x \to 1\) នាំឱ្យ ៖
\[\begin{aligned} &= e^1 = e \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} (\cos x)^{\frac{1}{\sin x}}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(1^\infty\) ៖
បំបែក \(\cos x = 1+(\cos x - 1)\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to 0} \left[(1+(\cos x-1))^{\frac{1}{\cos x-1}}\right]^{\frac{\cos x-1}{\sin x}} \end{aligned}\]
ដោយ \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\cos x-1}{\sin x} = 0\) នាំឱ្យ ៖
\[\begin{aligned} &= e^0 = 1 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} (1+3\tan^2 x)^{\cot^2 x}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(1^\infty\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to 0} \left[(1+3\tan^2 x)^{\frac{1}{3\tan^2 x}}\right]^{3\tan^2 x\cot^2 x}\\ &= e^3 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \sqrt[\sin x]{1+x}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(1^\infty\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to 0} (1+x)^{\frac{1}{\sin x}} = \lim_{x \to 0} \left[(1+x)^{\frac{1}{x}}\right]^{\frac{x}{\sin x}}\\ &= e^1 = e \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} (1+x)^{\frac{1}{\sin 3x}}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(1^\infty\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to 0} \left[(1+x)^{\frac{1}{x}}\right]^{\frac{x}{\sin 3x}} = e^{1/3} = \sqrt[3]{e} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} (x+2^x)^{\frac{1}{x}}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(1^\infty\) ៖
បំបែក \(x+2^x = 1+(x+2^x-1)\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to 0} \left[(1+(x+2^x-1))^{\frac{1}{x+2^x-1}}\right]^{\frac{x+2^x-1}{x}} \end{aligned}\]
ដោយ \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{x+2^x-1}{x} = 1+\ln 2\) នាំឱ្យ ៖
\[\begin{aligned} &= e^{1+\ln 2} = e \cdot e^{\ln 2} = 2e \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} (\cos x+\sin x)^{\frac{1}{x}}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(1^\infty\) ៖
បំបែក \(\cos x+\sin x = 1+(\cos x-1+\sin x)\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= e^{\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\cos x-1+\sin x}{x}}\\ &= e^{\lim_{x \to 0} \left(\frac{\cos x-1}{x} + \frac{\sin x}{x}\right)}\\ &= e^{0+1} = e \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0^+} (1+\tan^2\sqrt{x})^{\frac{1}{2x}}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(1^\infty\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to 0^+} \left[(1+\tan^2\sqrt{x})^{\frac{1}{\tan^2\sqrt{x}}}\right]^{\frac{\tan^2\sqrt{x}}{2x}} \end{aligned}\]
ដោយ \(\lim_{x \to 0^+} \frac{\tan^2\sqrt{x}}{2x} = \frac{1}{2}(1)^2 = \frac{1}{2}\) នាំឱ្យ ៖
\[\begin{aligned} &= e^{1/2} = \sqrt{e} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \left(\frac{x^2-x+1}{x^2+x+1}\right)^{\frac{1}{\sin x}}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(1^\infty\) ៖
បំបែក \(\frac{x^2-x+1}{x^2+x+1} = 1 - \frac{2x}{x^2+x+1}\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to 0} \left[\left(1-\frac{2x}{x^2+x+1}\right)^{-\frac{x^2+x+1}{2x}}\right]^{\frac{-2x}{(x^2+x+1)\sin x}} \end{aligned}\]
ដោយ \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{-2x}{(x^2+x+1)\sin x} = -2\) នាំឱ្យ ៖
\[\begin{aligned} &= e^{-2} = \frac{1}{e^2} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \left(\frac{\sin x}{x}\right)^{\frac{\tan x}{x-\sin x}}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(1^\infty\) ៖
បំបែក \(\frac{\sin x}{x} = 1 + \frac{\sin x-x}{x}\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to 0} \left[\left(1+\frac{\sin x-x}{x}\right)^{\frac{x}{\sin x-x}}\right]^{\frac{\sin x-x}{x}\cdot\frac{\tan x}{x-\sin x}}\\ &= e^{\lim_{x \to 0} \left(-\frac{\tan x}{x}\right)} = e^{-1} = \frac{1}{e} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} (2-2\cos x)^{\frac{1}{x^2}}\)៖
ជំនួស \(x=0\) ៖ មូលដ្ឋាន \(2-2(1)=0\)
ស្វ័យគុណ \(\frac{1}{x^2} \to +\infty\) ៖ ជារាង \(0^{+\infty}\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= 0 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 1} (1+\sin\pi x)^{\cot\pi x}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(1^\infty\) ៖
តាង \(t = x-1 \implies x = t+1\) ។ កាលណា \(x \to 1 \implies t \to 0\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{t \to 0} (1-\sin\pi t)^{\cot\pi t}\\ &= \lim_{t \to 0} \left[(1-\sin\pi t)^{-\frac{1}{\sin\pi t}}\right]^{-\cos\pi t}\\ &= e^{-\cos 0} = e^{-1} = \frac{1}{e} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} (1+2x^2)^{\cot^2 x}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(1^\infty\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to 0} \left[(1+2x^2)^{\frac{1}{2x^2}}\right]^{2x^2\cot^2 x}\\ &= e^{\lim_{x \to 0} 2\left(\frac{x}{\tan x}\right)^2} = e^{2(1)^2} = e^2 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{n \to 0} \left(1+\sin\frac{n}{2}\right)^{\frac{1}{n}}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(1^\infty\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{n \to 0} \left[\left(1+\sin\frac{n}{2}\right)^{\frac{1}{\sin(n/2)}}\right]^{\frac{\sin(n/2)}{n}}\\ &= e^{\lim_{n \to 0} \frac{\sin(n/2)}{2(n/2)}} = e^{1/2} = \sqrt{e} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} (\cos x+\sin^2 x)^{\frac{1}{x^2}}\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(1^\infty\) ៖
បំបែក \(\cos x+\sin^2 x = 1+(\cos x-1+\sin^2 x)\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= e^{\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\cos x-1+\sin^2 x}{x^2}} = e^{-\frac{1}{2}+1} = e^{1/2} = \sqrt{e} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to +\infty} x^{\frac{1}{x}}\)៖
ជារាង \(\infty^0\) ៖
សរសេរ \(x^{\frac{1}{x}} = e^{\frac{\ln x}{x}}\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= e^{\lim_{x \to +\infty} \frac{\ln x}{x}} = e^0 = 1 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to \infty} \left(\frac{x+a}{x+b}\right)^x\)៖
ជារាងមិនកំណត់ \(1^\infty\) ៖
បំបែក \(\frac{x+a}{x+b} = 1+\frac{a-b}{x+b}\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to \infty} \left[\left(1+\frac{a-b}{x+b}\right)^{\frac{x+b}{a-b}}\right]^{\frac{(a-b)x}{x+b}}\\ &= e^{a-b} \end{aligned}\]

ដំណោះស្រាយ

ប្រធាន៖ ចូរដោះស្រាយលីមីតខាងក្រោមឲ្យបានត្រឹមត្រូវ៖
. \(\lim_{n \to \infty} \left(\frac{1}{n^2} + \frac{2}{n^2} + \dots + \frac{n-1}{n^2}\right)\)៖
ផលបូកភាគយក ៖
\(S_{n-1} = 1 + 2 + \dots + (n-1) = \frac{n(n-1)}{2}\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{n \to \infty} \frac{n(n-1)}{2n^2} = \lim_{n \to \infty} \frac{n^2-n}{2n^2} = \frac{1}{2} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{n \to \infty} \left[\frac{1+3+\dots+(2n-1)}{n+1} - \frac{1}{2n+3}\right]\)៖
ផលបូកចំនួនសេស \(n\) តួដំបូង ៖
\(S_n = 1 + 3 + \dots + (2n-1) = n^2\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{n \to \infty} \left(\frac{n^2}{n+1} - \frac{1}{2n+3}\right)\\ &= +\infty - 0 = +\infty \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{n \to \infty} \frac{1+2+3+\dots+n}{\sqrt{9n^4+1}}\)៖
ផលបូកភាគយក ៖ \(S_n = \frac{n(n+1)}{2}\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{n \to \infty} \frac{n^2+n}{2\sqrt{9n^4+1}} = \lim_{n \to \infty} \frac{n^2(1+\frac{1}{n})}{2n^2\sqrt{9+\frac{1}{n^4}}}\\ &= \frac{1}{2\sqrt{9}} = \frac{1}{6} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{n \to \infty} \frac{1+3+5+\dots+(2n-1)}{1+2+3+\dots+n}\)៖
ភាគយក \(S_1 = n^2\) ; ភាគបែង \(S_2 = \frac{n(n+1)}{2}\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{n \to \infty} \frac{n^2}{\frac{n(n+1)}{2}} = \lim_{n \to \infty} \frac{2n^2}{n^2+n} = 2 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{n \to \infty} \left[\frac{1+3+5+\dots+(2n-1)}{n+3} - n\right]\)៖
ផលបូកភាគយកគឺ \(n^2\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{n \to \infty} \left(\frac{n^2}{n+3} - n\right) = \lim_{n \to \infty} \frac{n^2-n(n+3)}{n+3}\\ &= \lim_{n \to \infty} \frac{-3n}{n+3} = -3 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{n \to \infty} \frac{1+4+7+\dots+(3n-2)}{\sqrt{5n^2+n+1}}\)៖
ភាគយក \(S_n = \frac{n(1+3n-2)}{2} = \frac{3n^2-n}{2}\) ៖
ដឺក្រេភាគយក (\(2\)) ធំជាងភាគបែង (\(1\)) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{n \to \infty} \frac{3n^2-n}{2\sqrt{5n^2+n+1}} = +\infty \end{aligned}\]
(កត់សម្គាល់៖ បើភាគបែង \(\sqrt{5n^4}\) នោះលីមីតគឺ \(\frac{3}{2\sqrt{5}}\))

. \(\lim_{n \to \infty} \frac{1+\frac{1}{3}+\dots+\frac{1}{3^n}}{1+\frac{1}{5}+\dots+\frac{1}{5^n}}\)៖
ផលបូកស្វ៊ីតធរណីមាត្រអនន្ត ៖
ភាគយក ៖ \(S_1 = \frac{1}{1-1/3} = \frac{3}{2}\)
ភាគបែង ៖ \(S_2 = \frac{1}{1-1/5} = \frac{5}{4}\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \frac{3/2}{5/4} = \frac{3}{2} \cdot \frac{4}{5} = \frac{6}{5} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{n \to \infty} \frac{1-3+5-7+\dots-(4n-1)}{\sqrt{n^2+1}+\sqrt{n^2+n+1}}\)៖
ផ្ដុំតួភាគយកជាគូៗ (\(n\) គូ) ៖
\((1-3)+(5-7)+\dots = -2n\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{n \to \infty} \frac{-2n}{\sqrt{n^2+1}+\sqrt{n^2+n+1}} = \frac{-2}{1+1} = -1 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{n \to \infty} \frac{1-2+3-4+\dots-2n}{\sqrt{9n^2+1}}\)៖
ផ្ដុំតួភាគយកជាគូៗ (\(n\) គូ) ៖
\((1-2)+(3-4)+\dots = -n\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{n \to \infty} \frac{-n}{\sqrt{9n^2+1}} = \frac{-1}{\sqrt{9}} = -\frac{1}{3} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{n \to \infty} \frac{\sqrt[3]{n^3+5}-\sqrt{3n^4+2}}{1+2+3+\dots+(2n-1)}\)៖
ភាគបែង \(S = \frac{(2n-1)(2n)}{2} = 2n^2-n\) ៖
តួដឺក្រេធំបំផុតភាគយកគឺ \(-\sqrt{3}n^2\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{n \to \infty} \frac{n-\sqrt{3}n^2}{2n^2-n} = -\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{n \to \infty} \left(\frac{n+2}{1+2+3+\dots+n} - \frac{2}{3}\right)\)៖
ជំនួស \(1+2+\dots+n = \frac{n(n+1)}{2}\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{n \to \infty} \left(\frac{2(n+2)}{n(n+1)} - \frac{2}{3}\right) = 0 - \frac{2}{3} = -\frac{2}{3} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{n \to \infty} \sum_{k=1}^n \frac{3^k+2^k}{6^k}\)៖
បំបែក \(u_k = \left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^k + \left(\frac{1}{3}\right)^k\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} S_1 &= \sum_{k=1}^\infty \left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^k = \frac{1/2}{1-1/2} = 1\\ S_2 &= \sum_{k=1}^\infty \left(\frac{1}{3}\right)^k = \frac{1/3}{1-1/3} = \frac{1}{2}\\ S &= 1 + \frac{1}{2} = \frac{3}{2} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{n \to \infty} \frac{2-5+4-7+\dots-(2n+3)}{n+3}\)៖
ផ្ដុំតួភាគយកជាគូៗ (\(n\) គូ) ៖
\((2-5)+(4-7)+\dots = -3n\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{n \to \infty} \frac{-3n}{n+3} = -3 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{n \to \infty} \frac{1+2+3+\dots+n}{n-n^2+3}\)៖
ភាគយក \(S_n = \frac{n^2+n}{2}\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{n \to \infty} \frac{n^2+n}{2(-n^2+n+3)} = \frac{1}{2(-1)} = -\frac{1}{2} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{n \to \infty} \frac{n^2+\sqrt{n}-1}{2+7+12+\dots+(5n-3)}\)៖
ភាគបែង \(S_n = \frac{n(2+5n-3)}{2} = \frac{5n^2-n}{2}\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{n \to \infty} \frac{2(n^2+\sqrt{n}-1)}{5n^2-n} = \frac{2}{5} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{n \to \infty} \sum_{k=1}^n \frac{1+2^k}{4^k}\)៖
បំបែក \(u_k = \left(\frac{1}{4}\right)^k + \left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^k\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} S_1 &= \frac{1/4}{1-1/4} = \frac{1}{3}\\ S_2 &= \frac{1/2}{1-1/2} = 1\\ S &= \frac{1}{3} + 1 = \frac{4}{3} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{n \to \infty} \frac{2+4+6+\dots+2n}{1+3+5+\dots+(2n-1)}\)៖
ភាគយក \(n(n+1) = n^2+n\) ; ភាគបែង \(n^2\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{n \to \infty} \frac{n^2+n}{n^2} = 1 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{n \to \infty} \left[\frac{1+5+\dots+(4n-3)}{n+1} - \frac{4n-1}{2}\right]\)៖
ភាគយកជាស្វ៊ីតនព្វន្ត \(S_n = 2n^2-n\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{n \to \infty} \left[\frac{2n^2-n}{n+1} - \frac{4n-1}{2}\right]\\ &= \lim_{n \to \infty} \frac{2(2n^2-n)-(4n-1)(n+1)}{2(n+1)}\\ &= \lim_{n \to \infty} \frac{-5n+1}{2n+2} = -\frac{5}{2} \end{aligned}\]

ដំណោះស្រាយ

ប្រធាន៖ ដោះស្រាយលីមីតខាងក្រោមឲ្យបានត្រឹមត្រូវ៖
. \(\lim_{n \to \infty} \frac{1-2+3-4+\dots+(2n-1)-2n}{\sqrt[3]{n^3+2n+2}}\)៖
ផ្គុំភាគយកជា \(n\) គូ ៖

\[\begin{aligned} S_n &= (1-2) + (3-4) + \dots + [(2n-1)-2n]\\ &= \underbrace{(-1) + (-1) + \dots + (-1)}_{n \text{ តួ}} = -n \end{aligned}\]
ជំនួសចូលលីមីត ៖
\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{n \to \infty} \frac{-n}{\sqrt[3]{n^3+2n+2}}\\ &= \lim_{n \to \infty} \frac{-n}{n\sqrt[3]{1+\frac{2}{n^2}+\frac{2}{n^3}}} = -1 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{n \to \infty} \frac{3+6+9+\dots+3n}{n^2+4}\)៖
ភាគយកទាញ \(3\) ជាកត្តា ៖

\[\begin{aligned} S_n &= 3 \cdot \frac{n(n+1)}{2} = \frac{3n^2+3n}{2} \end{aligned}\]
ជំនួសចូលលីមីត ៖
\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{n \to \infty} \frac{3n^2+3n}{2(n^2+4)} = \lim_{n \to \infty} \frac{3n^2}{2n^2} = \frac{3}{2} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{n \to \infty} \left[\frac{2+4+\dots+2n}{n+3} - n\right]\)៖
ផលបូកភាគយក \(2+4+\dots+2n = n(n+1)\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{n \to \infty} \left[\frac{n^2+n}{n+3} - n\right]\\ &= \lim_{n \to \infty} \frac{n^2+n - n(n+3)}{n+3}\\ &= \lim_{n \to \infty} \frac{-2n}{n+3} = -2 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{n \to \infty} \left[\frac{7}{10} + \frac{29}{100} + \dots + \frac{2^n+5^n}{10^n}\right]\)៖
តួទូទៅ \(u_k = \frac{2^k+5^k}{10^k} = \left(\frac{1}{5}\right)^k + \left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^k\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} S_1 &= \sum_{k=1}^\infty \left(\frac{1}{5}\right)^k = \frac{1/5}{1-1/5} = \frac{1}{4}\\ S_2 &= \sum_{k=1}^\infty \left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^k = \frac{1/2}{1-1/2} = 1\\ S &= S_1 + S_2 = \frac{1}{4} + 1 = \frac{5}{4} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{n \to \infty} \left[\frac{27}{100} + \frac{27}{100^2} + \dots + \frac{27}{100^n}\right]\)៖
ស្វ៊ីតធរណីមាត្រអនន្ត \(u_1 = \frac{27}{100}\) និង \(q = \frac{1}{100}\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} S &= \frac{u_1}{1-q} = \frac{27/100}{1-1/100} = \frac{27}{99} = \frac{3}{11} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{n \to \infty} \left(\sqrt{2}\cdot\sqrt[4]{2}\cdot\sqrt[8]{2}\cdots\sqrt[2^n]{2}\right)\)៖
សរសេរជាស្វ័យគុណ ៖

\[\begin{aligned} u_n &= 2^{\frac{1}{2} + \frac{1}{4} + \frac{1}{8} + \dots + \frac{1}{2^n}}\\ S &= \sum_{k=1}^\infty \left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^k = \frac{1/2}{1-1/2} = 1\\ \lim_{n \to \infty} u_n &= 2^1 = 2 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{n \to \infty} \sqrt{a\sqrt{a\sqrt{a\cdots\sqrt{a}}}} \quad{} (a > 0)\)៖
សរសេរជាស្វ័យគុណ ៖

\[\begin{aligned} u_n &= a^{\frac{1}{2} + \frac{1}{4} + \dots + \frac{1}{2^n}}\\ S &= \sum_{k=1}^\infty \left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^k = \frac{1/2}{1-1/2} = 1\\ \lim_{n \to \infty} u_n &= a^1 = a \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{n \to \infty} \sqrt{2\sqrt{2\sqrt{2\cdots\sqrt{2}}}}\)៖
អនុវត្តលទ្ធផលពីលំហាត់ (ឆ) ចំពោះ \(a = 2\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} L &= 2 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{n \to \infty} \sqrt{a\sqrt{b\sqrt{a\sqrt{b\cdots}}}} \quad{} (a,b > 0)\)៖
តាង \(L = \lim_{n \to \infty} u_n\) ។ លើកជាការេ ៖

\[\begin{aligned} L^2 &= a\sqrt{b\sqrt{a\sqrt{b\cdots}}}\\ L^4 &= a^2 b \sqrt{a\sqrt{b\cdots}} = a^2 b L\\ L^3 &= a^2 b \implies L = \sqrt[3]{a^2 b} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{n \to \infty} \sqrt{3\sqrt{5\sqrt{3\sqrt{5\cdots}}}}\)៖
អនុវត្តលទ្ធផលពី (ឈ) ចំពោះ \(a = 3, b = 5\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} L &= \sqrt[3]{3^2 \cdot 5} = \sqrt[3]{45} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{n \to \infty} \left[1 - \frac{1}{3} + \frac{1}{9} - \frac{1}{27} + \dots + \frac{(-1)^{n-1}}{3^{n-1}}\right]\)៖
ស្វ៊ីតធរណីមាត្រអនន្ត \(u_1 = 1\) និង \(q = -\frac{1}{3}\) ៖
ដោយ \(|q| = \frac{1}{3} < 1\) ផលបូកអនន្តគឺ ៖

\[\begin{aligned} S &= \frac{u_1}{1-q} = \frac{1}{1 - \left(-\frac{1}{3}\right)}\\ &= \frac{1}{1 + \frac{1}{3}} = \frac{1}{4/3} = \frac{3}{4} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{n \to \infty} \frac{1+a+a^2+\dots+a^n}{1+b+b^2+\dots+b^n} \quad{} (|a| < 1, |b| < 1)\)៖
ភាគយក \(S_a = \frac{1}{1-a}\) ; ភាគបែង \(S_b = \frac{1}{1-b}\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} \lim_{n \to \infty} \frac{S_a}{S_b} &= \frac{\frac{1}{1-a}}{\frac{1}{1-b}} = \frac{1-b}{1-a} \end{aligned}\]

ដំណោះស្រាយ

ប្រធាន៖ ដោយប្រើទ្រឹស្ដីបទឡូពីតាល់ (L’Hôpital) ចូរដោះស្រាយលីមីតខាងក្រោម៖
. \(\lim_{x \to +\infty} \frac{\ln x}{\sqrt{x}}\)៖
រាង \(\frac{\infty}{\infty}\) ។ ប្រើឡូពីតាល់ ៖

\[\begin{aligned} \lim_{x \to +\infty} \frac{(\ln x)'}{(\sqrt{x})'} &= \lim_{x \to +\infty} \frac{\frac{1}{x}}{\frac{1}{2\sqrt{x}}}\\ &= \lim_{x \to +\infty} \frac{2}{\sqrt{x}} = 0 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to +\infty} \frac{x+\ln x}{x\ln x}\)៖
រាង \(\frac{\infty}{\infty}\) ។ ប្រើឡូពីតាល់ ៖

\[\begin{aligned} \lim_{x \to +\infty} \frac{(x+\ln x)'}{(x\ln x)'} &= \lim_{x \to +\infty} \frac{1+\frac{1}{x}}{\ln x+1}\\ &= \frac{1+0}{+\infty} = 0 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to +\infty} \frac{x^2}{e^{x}}\)៖
រាង \(\frac{\infty}{\infty}\) ។ ប្រើឡូពីតាល់ពីរដង ៖

\[\begin{aligned} \lim_{x \to +\infty} \frac{x^2}{e^{x}} &= \lim_{x \to +\infty} \frac{2x}{e^{x}}\\ &= \lim_{x \to +\infty} \frac{2}{e^{x}} = 0 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to +\infty} \frac{\ln(1+e^{x})}{x}\)៖
រាង \(\frac{\infty}{\infty}\) ។ ប្រើឡូពីតាល់ ៖

\[\begin{aligned} \lim_{x \to +\infty} \frac{\frac{e^{x}}{1+e^{x}}}{1} &= \lim_{x \to +\infty} \frac{1}{e^{-x}+1}\\ &= \frac{1}{0+1} = 1 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0^+} x\ln x\)៖
រាង \(0\cdot(-\infty)\) ។ សរសេរជារាង \(\frac{-\infty}{+\infty}\) រួចប្រើឡូពីតាល់ ៖

\[\begin{aligned} \lim_{x \to 0^+} \frac{\ln x}{\frac{1}{x}} &= \lim_{x \to 0^+} \frac{\frac{1}{x}}{-\frac{1}{x^2}}\\ &= \lim_{x \to 0^+} (-x) = 0 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to +\infty} x\left(e^{\frac{1}{x}}-1\right)\)៖
រាង \(\infty\cdot 0\) ។ សរសេរជារាង \(\frac{0}{0}\) រួចប្រើឡូពីតាល់ ៖

\[\begin{aligned} \lim_{x \to +\infty} \frac{e^{\frac{1}{x}}-1}{\frac{1}{x}} &= \lim_{x \to +\infty} \frac{-\frac{1}{x^2}e^{\frac{1}{x}}}{-\frac{1}{x^2}}\\ &= \lim_{x \to +\infty} e^{\frac{1}{x}} = e^0 = 1 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0^+} \sqrt{x}\ln x\)៖
រាង \(0\cdot(-\infty)\) ។ សរសេរ \(\sqrt{x}\ln x = \frac{\ln x}{x^{-\frac{1}{2}}}\) រួចប្រើឡូពីតាល់ ៖

\[\begin{aligned} \lim_{x \to 0^+} \frac{\frac{1}{x}}{-\frac{1}{2}x^{-\frac{3}{2}}} &= \lim_{x \to 0^+} \left(-2\sqrt{x}\right) = 0 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \left(\frac{1}{x}-\frac{1}{\sin x}\right)\)៖
រាង \(\infty-\infty\) ។ ធ្វើផលដក ៖ \(\frac{1}{x}-\frac{1}{\sin x} = \frac{\sin x - x}{x\sin x}\) (រាង \(\frac{0}{0}\))

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\cos x - 1}{\sin x + x\cos x} \quad{} \left(\tfrac{0}{0}\right)\\ &= \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{-\sin x}{2\cos x - x\sin x} = \frac{0}{2} = 0 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 1} \left(\frac{1}{\ln x}-\frac{1}{x-1}\right)\)៖
រាង \(\infty-\infty\) ។ ធ្វើផលដក ៖ \(\frac{x-1-\ln x}{(x-1)\ln x}\) (រាង \(\frac{0}{0}\))

\[\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x \to 1} \frac{1-\frac{1}{x}}{\ln x + \frac{x-1}{x}} = \lim_{x \to 1} \frac{x-1}{x\ln x + x - 1}\\ &= \lim_{x \to 1} \frac{1}{\ln x + 2} = \frac{1}{0+2} = \frac{1}{2} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 1} \frac{x^3-2x^2+x}{x^2-1}\)៖
ជំនួស \(x = 1\) គេបានរាង \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។ ប្រើទ្រឹស្ដីបទឡូពីតាល់ ៖
ដេរីវេភាគយក ៖ \(\frac{d}{dx}(x^3-2x^2+x) = 3x^2-4x+1\)
ដេរីវេភាគបែង ៖ \(\frac{d}{dx}(x^2-1) = 2x\)

\[\begin{aligned} \lim_{x \to 1} \frac{3x^2-4x+1}{2x} &= \frac{3(1)^2-4(1)+1}{2(1)}\\ &= \frac{3-4+1}{2} = \frac{0}{2} = 0 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to +\infty} \frac{\ln(x^2+1)}{\ln x}\)៖
រាង \(\frac{\infty}{\infty}\) ។ ប្រើឡូពីតាល់ ៖

\[\begin{aligned} \lim_{x \to +\infty} \frac{\frac{2x}{x^2+1}}{\frac{1}{x}} &= \lim_{x \to +\infty} \frac{2x^2}{x^2+1}\\ &= \lim_{x \to +\infty} \frac{2}{1+\frac{1}{x^2}} = 2 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 3} \frac{x^3-9x}{x^4-3x^3-x+3}\)៖
ជំនួស \(x = 3\) បានរាង \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។ ប្រើឡូពីតាល់ ៖
ដេរីវេភាគយក ៖ \(\frac{d}{dx}(x^3-9x) = 3x^2-9\)
ដេរីវេភាគបែង ៖ \(\frac{d}{dx}(x^4-3x^3-x+3) = 4x^3-9x^2-1\)
ជំនួស \(x = 3\) ៖
ភាគយក ៖ \(3(9)-9 = 27-9 = 18\)
ភាគបែង ៖ \(4(27)-9(9)-1 = 108-81-1 = 26\)

\[\begin{aligned} \lim_{x \to 3} \frac{3x^2-9}{4x^3-9x^2-1} &= \frac{18}{26} = \frac{9}{13} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 1} \frac{\sqrt[3]{8x}-2x}{\sqrt[4]{x}-x}\)៖
ជំនួស \(x = 1\) បានរាង \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។ ប្រើឡូពីតាល់ ៖
\(\sqrt[3]{8x} = 2x^{1/3} \implies (2x^{1/3})' = \frac{2}{3}x^{-2/3}\) នាំឲ្យភាគយកដេរីវេបាន \(\frac{2}{3}x^{-2/3}-2\) ។
ភាគបែង \(\sqrt[4]{x} = x^{1/4} \implies (x^{1/4})' = \frac{1}{4}x^{-3/4}\) នាំឲ្យភាគបែងដេរីវេបាន \(\frac{1}{4}x^{-3/4}-1\) ។
ជំនួស \(x = 1\) ចំពោះកន្សោមថ្មី ៖

\[\begin{aligned} \lim_{x \to 1} \frac{\frac{2}{3}x^{-2/3}-2}{\frac{1}{4}x^{-3/4}-1} &= \frac{\frac{2}{3}(1)-2}{\frac{1}{4}(1)-1} = \frac{\frac{2}{3}-\frac{6}{3}}{\frac{1}{4}-\frac{4}{4}}\\ &= \frac{-4/3}{-3/4} = \frac{16}{9} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{5^x-1}{x}\)៖
រាង \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។ ប្រើឡូពីតាល់ ៖
ដេរីវេភាគយក ៖ \(\frac{d}{dx}(5^x-1) = 5^x \ln 5\)
ដេរីវេភាគបែង ៖ \(\frac{d}{dx}(x) = 1\)

\[\begin{aligned} \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{5^x \ln 5}{1} &= 5^0 \ln 5 = 1 \cdot \ln 5 = \ln 5 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{e^x-e^{-x}}{x}\)៖
រាង \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។ ប្រើឡូពីតាល់ ៖
ដេរីវេភាគយក ៖ \(e^x - e^{-x}(-1) = e^x + e^{-x}\)
ដេរីវេភាគបែង ៖ \(1\)

\[\begin{aligned} \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{e^x+e^{-x}}{1} &= e^0 + e^0 = 1 + 1 = 2 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 1} \frac{\sqrt{x+1}-\sqrt{2}}{x^2-1}\)៖
រាង \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។ ប្រើឡូពីតាល់ ៖
ដេរីវេភាគយក ៖ \(\frac{d}{dx}(\sqrt{x+1}) = \frac{1}{2\sqrt{x+1}}\)
ដេរីវេភាគបែង ៖ \(\frac{d}{dx}(x^2-1) = 2x\)

\[\begin{aligned} \lim_{x \to 1} \frac{\frac{1}{2\sqrt{x+1}}}{2x} &= \frac{\frac{1}{2\sqrt{2}}}{2} = \frac{1}{4\sqrt{2}} = \frac{\sqrt{2}}{8} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 1} \frac{3x^3-3}{3^x-3}\)៖
រាង \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។ ប្រើឡូពីតាល់ ៖
ដេរីវេភាគយក ៖ \(9x^2\)
ដេរីវេភាគបែង ៖ \(3^x \ln 3\)

\[\begin{aligned} \lim_{x \to 1} \frac{9x^2}{3^x \ln 3} &= \frac{9(1)^2}{3^1 \ln 3} = \frac{9}{3\ln 3} = \frac{3}{\ln 3} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{e^x-1}{x^2}\)៖
រាង \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។ ប្រើឡូពីតាល់ ៖
ដេរីវេភាគយក ៖ \(e^x\)
ដេរីវេភាគបែង ៖ \(2x\) ភាគយក \(e^x \to 1 > 0\) ហើយភាគបែង \(2x \to 0\) ៖
- កាលណា \(x \to 0^+ \implies 2x > 0 \implies \lim_{x\to 0^+}\frac{e^x}{2x} = +\infty\)
- កាលណា \(x \to 0^- \implies 2x < 0 \implies \lim_{x\to 0^-}\frac{e^x}{2x} = -\infty\)
ដោយលីមីតឆ្វេង និងស្ដាំខុសគ្នា

. \(\lim_{x \to \frac{\pi}{3}} \frac{1-\cos x}{\pi - 3x}\)៖
ជំនួស \(x = \frac{\pi}{3}\) ៖ \(1 - \cos\frac{\pi}{3} = 1 - \frac{1}{2} = \frac{1}{2}\) និង \(\pi - 3\left(\frac{\pi}{3}\right) = 0\) ។
រាងគឺ \(\frac{1/2}{0}\) (មិនមែនរាងមិនកំណត់ទេ) ដូច្នេះមិនចាំបាច់ប្រើឡូពីតាល់ទេ ៖
- កាលណា \(x \to \frac{\pi}{3}^- \implies \pi-3x > 0 \implies\) លីមីតស្មើ \(+\infty\)
- កាលណា \(x \to \frac{\pi}{3}^+ \implies \pi-3x < 0 \implies\) លីមីតស្មើ \(-\infty\)
ដោយលីមីតឆ្វេង និងស្ដាំខុសគ្នា

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\sin x}{e^x-1}\)៖
រាង \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។ ប្រើឡូពីតាល់ ៖
ដេរីវេភាគយក ៖ \(\cos x\)
ដេរីវេភាគបែង ៖ \(e^x\)

\[\begin{aligned} \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\cos x}{e^x} &= \frac{\cos 0}{e^0} = \frac{1}{1} = 1 \end{aligned}\]

ដំណោះស្រាយ

ប្រធាន៖ ដោយប្រើទ្រឹស្ដីបទឡូពីតាល់ ចូរដោះស្រាយលីមីតខាងក្រោម៖
. \(\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{\arctan 3x}{\arcsin 2x}\)
ជំនួស \(x = 0\) បានរាង \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។ អនុវត្តវិធានឡូពីតាល់ដោយធ្វើដេរីវេភាគយក និងភាគបែង ៖
ដេរីវេភាគយក ៖ \(\frac{d}{dx}(\arctan 3x) = \frac{(3x)'}{1+(3x)^2} = \frac{3}{1+9x^2}\) ។
ដេរីវេភាគបែង ៖ \(\frac{d}{dx}(\arcsin 2x) = \frac{(2x)'}{\sqrt{1-(2x)^2}} = \frac{2}{\sqrt{1-4x^2}}\) ។
ជំនួសចូលលីមីត ៖

\[\begin{aligned} \lim_{x\to 0}\frac{\frac{3}{1+9x^2}}{\frac{2}{\sqrt{1-4x^2}}} &= \frac{\frac{3}{1}}{\frac{2}{1}} = \frac{3}{2} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{x^3+\pi x}{\sin 3x}\)
រាង \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។ ប្រើឡូពីតាល់ ៖
ដេរីវេភាគយក ៖ \(3x^2+\pi\) ។
ដេរីវេភាគបែង ៖ \(3\cos 3x\) ។
ជំនួស \(x=0\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} \lim_{x\to 0}\frac{3x^2+\pi}{3\cos 3x} &= \frac{0+\pi}{3(1)} = \frac{\pi}{3} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{e^x-e^{-x}}{2x-\sin x}\)
ជំនួស \(x = 0\) បានរាង \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។ ប្រើឡូពីតាល់ ៖
ដេរីវេភាគយក ៖ \(e^x-e^{-x}(-1) = e^x+e^{-x}\) ។
ដេរីវេភាគបែង ៖ \(2-\cos x\) ។
ជំនួស \(x = 0\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} \lim_{x\to 0}\frac{e^x+e^{-x}}{2-\cos x} &= \frac{1+1}{2-1} = \frac{2}{1} = 2 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{\ln(1+4x)}{3^x-1}\)
រាង \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។ ប្រើឡូពីតាល់ ៖
ដេរីវេភាគយក ៖ \(\frac{4}{1+4x}\) ។
ដេរីវេភាគបែង ៖ \(3^x\ln 3\) ។
ជំនួស \(x = 0\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} \lim_{x\to 0}\frac{\frac{4}{1+4x}}{3^x\ln 3} &= \frac{4}{1\cdot \ln 3} = \frac{4}{\ln 3} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{\sin 4x}{\ln(1+\sin x)}\)
រាង \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។ ប្រើឡូពីតាល់ ៖
ដេរីវេភាគយក ៖ \(4\cos 4x\) ។
ដេរីវេភាគបែង ៖ \(\frac{\cos x}{1+\sin x}\) ។
ជំនួស \(x=0\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} \lim_{x\to 0}\frac{4\cos 4x}{\frac{\cos x}{1+\sin x}} &= \frac{4(1)}{\frac{1}{1+0}} = 4 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{\arctan x + x^2}{2^{3x}-3^{2x}}\)
រាង \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។ ប្រើឡូពីតាល់ ៖
ដេរីវេភាគយក ៖ \(\frac{1}{1+x^2}+2x\) ។
ដេរីវេភាគបែង ៖
\(3\cdot 2^{3x}\ln 2 - 2\cdot 3^{2x}\ln 3\) ។
ជំនួស \(x = 0\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} \lim_{x\to 0}\frac{\frac{1}{1+x^2}+2x}{3\cdot 2^{3x}\ln 2 - 2\cdot 3^{2x}\ln 3} &= \frac{\frac{1}{1+0}+0}{3\ln 2 - 2\ln 3} \\ &= \frac{1}{3\ln 2 - 2\ln 3} \end{aligned}\]
ដោយ \(3\ln 2 - 2\ln 3 = \ln(2^3)-\ln(3^2) = \ln\left(\frac{8}{9}\right)\) ។

. \(\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{e^{3x}-e^{-2x}}{2\arcsin x - \sin x}\)
រាង \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។ ប្រើឡូពីតាល់ ៖
ដេរីវេភាគយក ៖ \(3e^{3x}+2e^{-2x}\) ។
ដេរីវេភាគបែង ៖ \(\frac{2}{\sqrt{1-x^2}}-\cos x\) ។
ជំនួស \(x = 0\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} \lim_{x\to 0}\frac{3e^{3x}+2e^{-2x}}{\frac{2}{\sqrt{1-x^2}}-\cos x} &= \frac{3(1)+2(1)}{\frac{2}{1}-1} = \frac{5}{2-1} = 5 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{3\ln(1-2x)}{2\arctan 3x}\)
រាង \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។ ប្រើឡូពីតាល់ ៖
ដេរីវេភាគយក ៖ \(3\cdot \frac{-2}{1-2x} = \frac{-6}{1-2x}\) ។
ដេរីវេភាគបែង ៖ \(2\cdot \frac{3}{1+9x^2} = \frac{6}{1+9x^2}\) ។
ជំនួស \(x = 0\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} \lim_{x\to 0}\frac{\frac{-6}{1-2x}}{\frac{6}{1+9x^2}} &= \frac{-6/1}{6/1} = -1 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x\to \frac{\pi}{2}}\frac{\arctan\left(x-\frac{\pi}{2}\right)}{\pi - 2x}\)
រាង \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។ ប្រើឡូពីតាល់ ៖
ដេរីវេភាគយក ៖ \(\frac{1}{1+(x-\pi/2)^2}\) ។
ដេរីវេភាគបែង ៖ \(-2\) ។
ជំនួស \(x = \frac{\pi}{2}\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} \lim_{x\to \frac{\pi}{2}}\frac{\frac{1}{1+(x-\pi/2)^2}}{-2} &= \frac{\frac{1}{1+0}}{-2} = -\frac{1}{2} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{\ln(\cos 3x)}{\arctan 4x}\)
រាង \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។ ប្រើឡូពីតាល់ ៖
ដេរីវេភាគយក ៖ \(\frac{(\cos 3x)'}{\cos 3x} = \frac{-3\sin 3x}{\cos 3x} = -3\tan 3x\) ។
ដេរីវេភាគបែង ៖ \(\frac{4}{1+16x^2}\) ។
ជំនួស \(x = 0\) ៖

\[\begin{aligned} \lim_{x\to 0}\frac{-3\tan 3x}{\frac{4}{1+16x^2}} &= \frac{-3\tan 0}{\frac{4}{1+0}} = \frac{0}{4} = 0 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{(1+x)^2-(1+2x)}{x^2+4x^3}\)
ជំនួស \(x = 0\) បានរាង \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។
យើងអាចពន្លាតភាគយកមុននឹងធ្វើដេរីវេ ៖
\((1+x)^2-(1+2x) = 1+2x+x^2-1-2x = x^2\) ។
លីមីតក្លាយជា ៖

\[\begin{aligned} \lim_{x\to 0}\frac{x^2}{x^2+4x^3} &= \lim_{x\to 0}\frac{x^2}{x^2(1+4x)} \\ &= \lim_{x\to 0}\frac{1}{1+4x} = \frac{1}{1} = 1 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{1-\cos^4 x}{4x^2}\)
រាង \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។ ប្រើឡូពីតាល់ ៖
ដេរីវេភាគយក ៖ \(-4\cos^3 x(-\sin x) = 4\cos^3 x\sin x\) ។
ដេរីវេភាគបែង ៖ \(8x\) ។

\[\begin{aligned} \lim_{x\to 0}\frac{4\cos^3 x\sin x}{8x} &= \lim_{x\to 0}\frac{1}{2}\cos^3 x\cdot \frac{\sin x}{x} \\ &= \frac{1}{2}(1)^3(1) = \frac{1}{2} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x\to -1}\frac{(x^2+3x+2)^2}{x^3-3x-2}\)
ជំនួស \(x = -1\) បានរាង \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។ បំបែកជាកត្តាសិន ៖
\(x^2+3x+2 = (x+1)(x+2)\) នាំឱ្យភាគយកគឺ \((x+1)^2(x+2)^2\) ។
ភាគបែង \(x^3-3x-2 = (x+1)^2(x-2)\) ។
លីមីតក្លាយជា ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &\lim_{x\to -1}\frac{(x+1)^2(x+2)^2}{(x+1)^2(x-2)} \\ &\quad{} = \lim_{x\to -1}\frac{(x+2)^2}{x-2} = \frac{(-1+2)^2}{-1-2} = -\frac{1}{3} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{1-\cos x}{2x\sin x}\)
រាង \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។ ប្រើឡូពីតាល់ ៖
ដេរីវេភាគយក ៖ \(\sin x\) ។
ដេរីវេភាគបែង ៖ \(2\sin x + 2x\cos x\) (តាមវិធានដេរីវេផលគុណ) ។
នាំឱ្យលីមីតក្លាយជា ៖

\[\begin{aligned} \lim_{x\to 0}\frac{\sin x}{2\sin x + 2x\cos x} \quad{} \left(\text{រាង } \frac{0}{0}\right) \end{aligned}\]
ប្រើឡូពីតាល់ម្ដងទៀត ៖
ដេរីវេភាគយកម្ដងទៀត ៖ \(\cos x\) ។
ដេរីវេភាគបែងម្ដងទៀត ៖
\(2\cos x + 2(\cos x - x\sin x)\)
\(= 4\cos x - 2x\sin x\) ។
ជំនួស \(x=0\) ៖
\[\begin{aligned} \lim_{x\to 0}\frac{\cos x}{4\cos x - 2x\sin x} &= \frac{1}{4(1)-0} = \frac{1}{4} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{x-\sin x}{e^x-e^{-x}-2x}\)
រាង \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។ ប្រើឡូពីតាល់ ៖
ដេរីវេទី១ ៖

\[\begin{aligned} \frac{1-\cos x}{e^x+e^{-x}-2} &\to \frac{0}{0} \end{aligned}\]
ដេរីវេទី២ ៖
\[\begin{aligned} \frac{\sin x}{e^x-e^{-x}} &\to \frac{0}{0} \end{aligned}\]
ដេរីវេទី៣ ៖
\[\begin{aligned} \lim_{x\to 0}\frac{\cos x}{e^x+e^{-x}} &= \frac{\cos 0}{e^0+e^{-0}} = \frac{1}{1+1} = \frac{1}{2} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{x^3}{x-\arctan x}\)
រាង \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។ ប្រើឡូពីតាល់ ៖
ដេរីវេទី១ ៖

\[\begin{aligned} \frac{3x^2}{1-\frac{1}{1+x^2}} &= \frac{3x^2}{\frac{1+x^2-1}{1+x^2}} = \frac{3x^2}{\frac{x^2}{1+x^2}} \\ &= 3(1+x^2) \end{aligned}\]
ជំនួស \(x=0\) ៖ \(3(1+0) = 3\) ។

. \(\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{e^{3x}-3x-1}{\sin^2 x}\)
រាង \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។ ប្រើឡូពីតាល់ ៖
ដេរីវេទី១ ៖

\[\begin{aligned} \frac{3e^{3x}-3}{2\sin x\cos x} &= \frac{3e^{3x}-3}{\sin 2x} \to \frac{0}{0} \end{aligned}\]
ដេរីវេទី២ ៖
\[\begin{aligned} \lim_{x\to 0}\frac{9e^{3x}}{2\cos 2x} &= \frac{9(1)}{2(1)} = \frac{9}{2} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\tan x-x}{x^3}\)៖
រាង \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។ ប្រើឡូពីតាល់ ៖

\[\begin{aligned} \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\frac{1}{\cos^2 x}-1}{3x^2} &= \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\tan^2 x}{3x^2}\\ &= \frac{1}{3}\left(\lim_{x \to 0}\frac{\tan x}{x}\right)^2 = \frac{1}{3} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{e^{x}-1-x}{x^2}\)៖
រាង \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។ ប្រើឡូពីតាល់ពីរដង ៖

\[\begin{aligned} \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{e^{x}-1-x}{x^2} &= \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{e^{x}-1}{2x}\\ &= \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{e^{x}}{2} = \frac{1}{2} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{x-\sin x}{x^3}\)៖
រាង \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។ ប្រើឡូពីតាល់ពីរដង ៖

\[\begin{aligned} \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{x-\sin x}{x^3} &= \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{1-\cos x}{3x^2}\\ &= \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\sin x}{6x} = \frac{1}{6} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\ln(1+x)-x}{x^2}\)៖
រាង \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។ ប្រើឡូពីតាល់ ៖

\[\begin{aligned} \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\frac{1}{1+x}-1}{2x} &= \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{-x}{2x(1+x)}\\ &= \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{-1}{2(1+x)} = -\frac{1}{2} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 1} \frac{\ln x}{x^2-1}\)៖
រាង \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។ ប្រើឡូពីតាល់ ៖

\[\begin{aligned} \lim_{x \to 1} \frac{\frac{1}{x}}{2x} &= \lim_{x \to 1} \frac{1}{2x^2} = \frac{1}{2} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{2^{x}-3^{x}}{x}\)៖
រាង \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។ ប្រើឡូពីតាល់ ៖ (ដោយ \((a^x)' = a^x\ln a\))

\[\begin{aligned} \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{2^{x}\ln 2-3^{x}\ln 3}{1} &= \ln 2-\ln 3 = \ln\frac{2}{3} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{1-\cos 3x}{x\sin x}\)៖
រាង \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។ ប្រើឡូពីតាល់ពីរដង ៖

\[\begin{aligned} \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{1-\cos 3x}{x\sin x} &= \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{3\sin 3x}{\sin x + x\cos x}\\ &= \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{9\cos 3x}{2\cos x - x\sin x} = \frac{9}{2} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to \pi} \frac{\sin x}{\pi-x}\)៖
រាង \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។ ប្រើឡូពីតាល់ ៖

\[\begin{aligned} \lim_{x \to \pi} \frac{\cos x}{-1} &= -\cos\pi = -(-1) = 1 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{e^{2x}-\cos x}{x}\)៖
រាង \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។ ប្រើឡូពីតាល់ ៖

\[\begin{aligned} \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{2e^{2x}+\sin x}{1} &= 2e^0+\sin 0 = 2 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\arcsin x-x}{x^3}\)៖
រាង \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។ ប្រើឡូពីតាល់ ៖ (ដោយ \((\arcsin x)' = \frac{1}{\sqrt{1-x^2}}\))

\[\begin{aligned} &\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\frac{1}{\sqrt{1-x^2}}-1}{3x^2} = \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{1-\sqrt{1-x^2}}{3x^2\sqrt{1-x^2}}\\ &= \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{x^2}{3x^2\sqrt{1-x^2}\left(1+\sqrt{1-x^2}\right)}\\ &= \frac{1}{3\cdot 1\cdot(1+1)} = \frac{1}{6} \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{e^{x}-e^{-x}-2x}{x-\sin x}\)៖
រាង \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។ ប្រើឡូពីតាល់បីដង ៖

\[\begin{aligned} &\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{e^{x}-e^{-x}-2x}{x-\sin x} = \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{e^{x}+e^{-x}-2}{1-\cos x}\\ &= \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{e^{x}-e^{-x}}{\sin x} = \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{e^{x}+e^{-x}}{\cos x} = 2 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to \frac{\pi}{4}} \frac{\tan x-1}{x-\frac{\pi}{4}}\)៖
រាង \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។ ប្រើឡូពីតាល់ ៖

\[\begin{aligned} \lim_{x \to \frac{\pi}{4}} \frac{\frac{1}{\cos^2 x}}{1} &= \frac{1}{\cos^2\frac{\pi}{4}} = \frac{1}{\frac{1}{2}} = 2 \end{aligned}\]

. \(\lim_{x \to 2} \frac{x^2-4}{\ln(x-1)}\)៖
រាង \(\frac{0}{0}\) ។ ប្រើឡូពីតាល់ ៖

\[\begin{aligned} \lim_{x \to 2} \frac{2x}{\frac{1}{x-1}} &= \lim_{x \to 2} 2x(x-1) = 2(2)(1) = 4 \end{aligned}\]

ដំណោះស្រាយ

ប្រធាន៖ សិក្សាភាពជាប់ ឬកំណត់ប៉ារ៉ាម៉ែត្រ ដើម្បីឱ្យអនុគមន៍ជាប់ត្រង់ចំណុចដែលគេឲ្យ៖
. \(f(x)=\begin{cases}\frac{x^2-9}{x-3} & x\ne 3\\ 6 & x=3\end{cases}\) ត្រង់ \(x=3\)៖
គេមាន \(f(3)=6\) ។
\(\lim\limits_{x\to 3}\frac{x^2-9}{x-3}=\lim\limits_{x\to 3}\frac{(x-3)(x+3)}{x-3}=\lim\limits_{x\to 3}(x+3)=6\) ។
ដោយ \(\lim\limits_{x\to 3}f(x)=f(3)=6\)

. \(f(x)=\begin{cases}x^2+1 & x<1\\ 2x & x\ge 1\end{cases}\) ត្រង់ \(x=1\)៖
\(f(1)=2(1)=2\) ។
\(\lim\limits_{x\to 1^-}(x^2+1)=2\) និង \(\lim\limits_{x\to 1^+}2x=2\) ។
ដោយ \(\lim\limits_{x\to 1^-}f(x)=\lim\limits_{x\to 1^+}f(x)=f(1)\)

. \(f(x)=\begin{cases}\frac{\sin 2x}{x} & x\ne 0\\ 1 & x=0\end{cases}\) ត្រង់ \(x=0\)៖
\(f(0)=1\) និង \(\lim\limits_{x\to 0}\frac{\sin 2x}{x}=\lim\limits_{x\to 0}\left(2\cdot\frac{\sin 2x}{2x}\right)=2\) ។
ដោយ \(\lim\limits_{x\to 0}f(x)=2\ne f(0)\)

. រក \(m\)៖
\(\lim\limits_{x\to 0}\frac{\sqrt{x+4}-2}{x}=\lim\limits_{x\to 0}\frac{(x+4)-4}{x(\sqrt{x+4}+2)}=\lim\limits_{x\to 0}\frac{1}{\sqrt{x+4}+2}=\frac{1}{4}\) ។
\(f\) ជាប់ត្រង់ \(0\) លុះត្រាតែ \(f(0)=\lim\limits_{x\to 0}f(x)\)

. រក \(a\) និង \(b\)៖
\(f(1)=3\) ; \(\lim\limits_{x\to 1^-}(x+a)=1+a\) ; \(\lim\limits_{x\to 1^+}(bx^2+1)=b+1\) ។
\(f\) ជាប់ត្រង់ \(1\) លុះត្រាតែ \(1+a=3\) និង \(b+1=3\) ។

. \(f(x)=\frac{1-\cos x}{x^2}\) មិនកំណត់ត្រង់ \(0\) ។
\(\lim\limits_{x\to 0}\frac{1-\cos x}{x^2}=\lim\limits_{x\to 0}\frac{2\sin^2\frac{x}{2}}{x^2}=\frac{1}{2}\lim\limits_{x\to 0}\left(\frac{\sin\frac{x}{2}}{\frac{x}{2}}\right)^2=\frac{1}{2}\) ។

ដំណោះស្រាយ

ប្រធាន៖ ទ្រឹស្ដីបទតម្លៃកណ្ដាល និងអាស៊ីមតូត៖
. តាង \(f(x)=x^3-3x+1\) ជាអនុគមន៍ពហុធា ដូចនេះជាប់លើ \([0,1]\) ។
\(f(0)=1>0\) និង \(f(1)=-1<0\) នាំឱ្យ \(f(0)\cdot f(1)<0\) ។
តាមទ្រឹស្ដីបទតម្លៃកណ្ដាល

. តាង \(f(x)=xe^x-1\) ជាប់លើ \([0,1]\) ។
\(f(0)=-1<0\) និង \(f(1)=e-1>0\) ។
\(f'(x)=e^x+xe^x=(x+1)e^x>0\) លើ \(]0,1[\) នាំឱ្យ \(f\) កើនដាច់ខាត ។

. តាង \(g(x)=\sin x+x-1\) ជាប់លើ \(\left[0,\frac{\pi}{2}\right]\) ។
\(g(0)=-1<0\) និង \(g\left(\frac{\pi}{2}\right)=1+\frac{\pi}{2}-1=\frac{\pi}{2}>0\) ។

. \(D=\mathbb{R}\setminus\{2\}\) ។ ចែកពហុធាបាន \(f(x)=2x+1+\frac{3}{x-2}\) ។
\(\bullet\) \(\lim\limits_{x\to 2^+}f(x)=+\infty\) , \(\lim\limits_{x\to 2^-}f(x)=-\infty\) \(\Rightarrow\) \(x=2\) ជាអាស៊ីមតូតឈរ ។
\(\bullet\) \(\lim\limits_{x\to\pm\infty}\left[f(x)-(2x+1)\right]=\lim\limits_{x\to\pm\infty}\frac{3}{x-2}=0\) \(\Rightarrow\) \(y=2x+1\) ជាអាស៊ីមតូតទ្រេត ។

. \(D=\mathbb{R}\setminus\{-3\}\) ។ គេសរសេរ \(g(x)=-2+\frac{7}{x+3}\) ។
\(\bullet\) \(\lim\limits_{x\to\pm\infty}g(x)=-2\) \(\Rightarrow\) \(y=-2\) ជាអាស៊ីមតូតដេក ។
\(\bullet\) \(\lim\limits_{x\to -3^+}g(x)=+\infty\) , \(\lim\limits_{x\to -3^-}g(x)=-\infty\) \(\Rightarrow\) \(x=-3\) ជាអាស៊ីមតូតឈរ ។

. \(\lim\limits_{x\to +\infty}\frac{2e^x+1}{e^x+1}=\lim\limits_{x\to +\infty}\frac{2+e^{-x}}{1+e^{-x}}=2\) និង \(\lim\limits_{x\to -\infty}\frac{2e^x+1}{e^x+1}=\frac{0+1}{0+1}=1\) ។

ដំណោះស្រាយលំហាត់ប្រឡងថ្នាក់ជាតិ

ដំណោះស្រាយ

ប្រធាន៖ គណនាលីមីត \(\lim_{x\to 0} \frac{2-\sqrt{x+4}}{x}\) ។

ចម្លើយ៖ យើងមានលីមីតមានរាងមិនកំណត់ \(\left[\frac{0}{0}\right]\)

\[\begin{aligned} \lim_{x\to 0} \frac{2-\sqrt{x+4}}{x} &= \lim_{x\to 0} \frac{(2-\sqrt{x+4})(2+\sqrt{x+4})}{x(2+\sqrt{x+4})} \\ &= \lim_{x\to 0} \frac{4-(x+4)}{x(2+\sqrt{x+4})} \\ &= \lim_{x\to 0} \frac{-x}{x(2+\sqrt{x+4})} \\ &= \lim_{x\to 0} \frac{-1}{2+\sqrt{x+4}} \\ &= \frac{-1}{2+\sqrt{4}} = -\frac{1}{4} \end{aligned}\]
ដូចនេះ៖ \(\lim_{x\to 0} \frac{2-\sqrt{x+4}}{x} = -\frac{1}{4}\) ។

ដំណោះស្រាយ

ប្រធាន៖ \(f\) ជាអនុគមន៍កំណត់ដោយ \(f(x) = \begin{cases} x-2+\frac{e}{\ln x} & \text{បើ } x > 0 \text{ និង } x \neq 1 \\ m & \text{បើ } x = 0 \end{cases}\) ។ គណនា \(\lim_{x\to 0^+} f(x)\) ។

កំណត់តម្លៃ \(m\) ដើម្បីឲ្យអនុគមន៍ \(f\) ជាប់ខាងស្ដាំត្រង់ \(x = 0\) ។

ចម្លើយ៖

  • គណនាលីមីតខាងស្ដាំត្រង់ \(0\)៖
